Everybody loves that industrial look: tough, gritty, urban-chic. But quality construction and materials sure can be expensive, right? Enter Fauxdustrial Industries’ Hardcore Stairs: the look you crave, the price you can afford!

Note: Stair price is per step.
0xA0EC3E611EB24853:
We know you don't want to be called a tree killer when you install those beautiful wooden stairs in your home. So get Living Stairs! Made from a fast-growing sentient bamboo, Living Stairs are custom-grown to your specifications, and can continue to grow even after they are installed!

Note: Stair price is per step.
0xAA147A585CB00A6E:
There are five stages to staircase ownership: From denial to depression, it’s not a pretty journey. But eventually you arrive at acceptance, and when that happens, Stage Five Staircases will be waiting.

Note: Stair price is per step.

0x14F2C080F304335B: Sims will automatically cross an age barrier when it's time, but you can choose to have them grow up early by buying a birthday cake and throwing them a party! 0x83CADAFC8320EC37: Each icon in Build Mode represents tools you can use to shape your lot or objects, like doors and windows, that help create homes for your Sims.
0x83CADAFC8320EC34: One of the most useful tools in Build Mode is the Wall Tool, which lets you create new walls and rooms, which form the basic structure of any house.
0x83CADAFC8320EC35: Much of Build Mode is similar to Buy Mode - catalogs of objects that will help you build up your house. Certain objects like doors, windows, and arches can only go on walls.
0x83CADAFC8320EC32: There are also many special tools in Build Mode that let you do things like manipulate terrain, put wallpaper on the walls, put floor designs on the ground, and add pools to your backyard. You can also sell one or multiple objects with the Sledgehammer Tool.

0xDBEC514779892A28: Let's first look at this vertical group of swatches, called the Pattern Skewer. This skewer contains the individual patterns for the object or clothing that you have selected. Some objects have more patterns than others, and patterns at the top of the skewer affect a larger area on the object, while patterns near the bottom affect a smaller area.
0xDBEC514779892A2B: Next, here's the Pattern Library. This area contains patterns split into categories, which can be selected from the drop down menu at the top. Clicking on a pattern will place that pattern in the currently selected slot in the Pattern Skewer.
0xDBEC514779892A2A: Each pattern has up to four colors, and each can be individually changed. The colors are ordered such that the ones on the left affect a larger area and the ones on the right affect a smaller area. You can also select the larger swatch on the left and select a color to change all colors at the same time.
0xDBEC514779892A2D: This panel in the upper-left corner of the screen allows you to manage preset styles. It will display any previously designed styles for the current object, with the * representing a style-in-progress. On this panel, you can click on a saved preset to use that style, save the style you're currently working on, or delete previously saved styles. Custom styles will have a small icon in the corner of their thumbnails.
0xDBEC514779892A2C: Let’s look at the Pattern Skewer again. Notice the grip-dots at the top of the skewer. Clicking here will grab the skewer, allowing you to copy this entire style onto almost any other item by dragging it on to that object or piece of clothing.
0xDBEC514779892A2F: Individual patterns can be dragged similarly. Click and drag any pattern from the Pattern Skewer and it will attach to your cursor. You can now release the mouse button on another pattern in the skewer in order to overwrite it, click in between patterns on the skewer to re-order patterns, or click on another item to copy the pattern to that item.
0xDBEC514779892A2E: Individual colors, as well as the swatch representing combinations of colors, can be dragged in the same way. This is a great way to quickly get matching styles that use different patterns.
0xDBEC514779892A21: When you drag a pattern, individual color, or combination of colors from one object onto a different object, the Transfer Dialogue will appear. From here, you can choose which pattern on the new item to affect. Transferring a pattern will overwrite the old pattern, while colors will retain the pattern and only change its color information.

0x1B5323E8D1B0A770: All children and teens have school that starts at 9 AM during the week. Children get off of school at 3 PM, while teens are done at 2 PM. The school bus picks up and drops off students in front of their houses.
0x1B5323E8D1B0A773: While at school, students will get options on how to approach the school day. These options can affect the Sim's performance and after school activities. Sims who have not completed their homework will also get an additional option to work on it at school.
0x1B5323E8D1B0A772: Two factors affect a student’s performance: their mood and their homework. Students will receive an overall letter grade that is based on these two factors.
0x1B5323E8D1B0A775: To achieve honor roll status, students must have good grades three days in a row. If a student's grades slip, their honor roll status will be lost.
0x1B5323E8D1B0A774: Students who repeatedly have incomplete homework, a bad mood, or - worst of all - miss school entirely will start failing. Failing students will receive a day long negative moodlet.
0x1B5323E8D1B0A777: Even good students, if caught sleeping in class or cheating on their homework, will receive detention. Detention is served right after school and the student will have to walk or bike home afterwards.
0x1B5323E8D1B0A776: Doing well in school has its benefits, of course. Students with higher school performance will receive better traits on their birthdays. Be at the head of the class and you might even get to pick your trait!
0x1B5323E8D1B0A779: School's also a great place to make friends!  Sims can bring friends home from school or visit their friend's homes - with permission from their parents.

0x99CED47385F1C15E: The Time Controls in The Sims 3 are on this panel. The buttons give you the ability to pause time or to speed it up.

0x6FF35C41C85D5BA4: A small but mighty world once used for smoke testing, now abandoned due to the nefarious forces of the GPE consortium. Perhaps, though, there is one among the inhabitants of this benighted village who will strike a blow for freedom and justice...
0x060B540346480CB8: This sleek mid-century classic is perched on the verge of taking flight.
0xC9F366207FA3FD12: This white-painted country house anchors the west end of the Skyborough neighborhood, welcoming guests with an inviting, corner-facing porch.
0x07FB01DD22ABB874: This bungalow-style house awaits an owner to appreciate its historic allure. The large fireplace and second story sleeping porch are all original to this Craftsman house.
0x681CACC0E93DC43D: It’s big, spacious, and comfortable. This contemporary one-story house features soaring ceilings, a private deck and a large fenced-in yard.
0x2A3E58B8A0888383: Unique and austere, restrained modern architecture distinguishes this whitewashed view home with vaulted ceilings throughout.
0xC829E2E6675AA348: This traditional row house remains a classic. It’s topped by an attic and includes interconnected back porches for each of the four floors.
0x7E15C3E798FD4EFD: This modern, nautical-inspired home will inspire you to keep things ship shape while swabbing the deck of your new home.
0x857067604F5A02B0: The bright side is that this humble home is at least one step better than a tent since it comes complete with walls and floors that are mostly leak proof.
0x3B44975EC8C0F610: The interior of this A-frame house flashes back to the '70s with flair. The backyard includes a grove of pine trees and a massive deck.
0x70EC1BBFDFFC84B8: When you have reached that stage of life when suburban living has lost its appeal, it is time to move up to this stunning abode.
0xD3ED50CDB294F066: This fashionable contemporary house features a double height living room and open concept first floor.
0x9C0B4D17109E3568: An open floor plan, dramatic bridge entrance, and sweeping cove vistas distinguish this cantilevered view home. Built mostly on one level, this elegant modern home with its round cupola studio is ideal for the artistically inclined.
0xF2F9C48A0FC0A4F2: Conjuring up images of holiday cards and jovial family memories, either real or imagined, this traditional home awaits a family to turn it into the heartwarming home it longs to be.
0xE503F1A247F0A9B0: An alternative style of housing designed for the avant-garde who want an industrial style live/work space. These are true lofts with two-story open spaces that overlook the common pool area.
0x021FA39D27C1E775: This cozy Victorian cottage is as cute as a button. It features original details, a fireplace, and a large fenced-in yard.
0x593CBDA69CFBCC19: If you are seeking a quaint two bedroom home with lots of charm, this is the house for you. Despite its compact layout and affordable price, it still features fine craftsman style, a fireplace, carport and its own pond!
0xBDB2317ACC336F33: A one-story Tudor style cottage with its own pond, this unique home boasts a five-story observation tower perfect for the serious home astronomer.
0xD78CA646F2607952: The grand fireplace takes center stage in the spacious two-story great room. Three decks in the front and back of this simple mountain lodge offer plenty of opportunity for taking in the crisp alpine air.
0x810615DF12040595: This no frills country farm house features a well insulated sunroom, a cozy fireplace, and an additional family room. Located on a large agricultural plot. Garage and outhouse included.
0x5C7882243A454980: Long and low, this suburban ranch includes a two-car garage, shady front and back porches, and a large, open yard.
0x271CE50358908883: “Happily ever after” is the concept for this large Victorian home. It includes separate formal and informal living areas downstairs and a petite bathing pool in the yard.
0xA4A6297930D88E7A: This personality-rich fixer-upper sits on a convenient corner lot and features a fenced-in, paved yard.
0x79E86FE0DED0D33F: This romantic, Victorian cottage has an easy, one-story floor plan. The back porch overlooks a sizable yard that would be perfect for the do-it-yourself gardener.
0x48567B30D2AF753D: This house has a friendly, neighborly air about it. Come sit on the porch or gazebo and have some lemonade.
0x3EAB9E725C7AB9A3: Based on a time-honored design usually executed in gingerbread and icing, this little Victorian cottage is suitable for a young couple or the extremely unfashionable single seeking to stay that way.
0x393F38036310C0E1: Antiquated Victorian elegance has been preserved exquisitely in this landmark home. The first home built in this town, Goth Manor presides over the town and is located in convenient proximity to the local graveyard.
0xC6BA5676132E5D2D: This Arts and Crafts style home is family friendly with large rooms throughout its three stories. It features several porches and a sizable back yard with a spacious garden.
0xA9296B6BFB78913F: Simple, straightforward living space with ample view-framing windows, crackling fireplace, and a bonus loft characterize this compact home.
0x232CEFC3A1D01525: An elegant home on the most exclusive circle in town, this stately manor resounds with grandeur. Four fireplaces, a massive kitchen, formal and informal living areas, a large custom pool, two-car garage, and elegant neoclassical landscaping round out its elegant features.
0xAEECB408E69CF7A3: This prestigious home on a prime piece of real estate is perfect for the elite modern life. Amenities include his and hers master bathrooms, spacious vaulted living area, two pools, media loft, and extensive wrap-around decks that enjoy commanding views.
0x38FFB17145921224: Modest and livable... it’s a suburban ranch house. Thoughtful landscaping, a separate garage, and a large, uniquely-shaped deck complete this middle class dream.
0x47A6A3CCC5CDECEE: With its imposing façade and glittering entryway pool, this mansion is only for those who relish opulent living. Just imagine the parties you could have!
0xE501C97094192E97: Compact, vertically-oriented, cubist, Mediterranean. This contemporary three-story town home includes two decks and a balcony.

0x76D8801C9CB94076: Ancient Coins are one of the most common and useful treasures found throughout the tombs and caverns of Egypt, China, and France.
0x76D8801C9CB94075: Ancient Coins can be found in treasure chests, under rubble piles, at the bottom of dive wells, or even lying on the ground. Search every crevice to find them!
0x76D8801C9CB94074: Ancient Coins can be used to purchase special Adventure Rewards from the special merchant. There is a special merchant wandering around the marketplace of each destination.

0x288B64CACE7F21E7: Check the local Adventure Board to sign up for exciting and rewarding Adventures!
0x288B64CACE7F21E0: Visit the local market in town to purchase foreign wares, relics, survival gear, and even Adventure Rewards!

0xC7EF515D7E83BC95: Expensive equipment shouldn't keep your Sims from a healthy lifestyle or increasing their Athletic Skill. Sims can use the equipment at the local gym for free or work out using their TV or Stereo.
0xC7EF515D7E83BC96: Different workout types will determine your Sims' physical conditioning. Cardio exercise on the treadmill will lead to a leaner Sim, whereas strength workouts at the weight bench will increase a Sim's bulk.
0xC7EF515D7E83BC97: Sims' endurance improves as they workout, meaning it takes them longer to become fatigued.  Furthermore, higher level Athletic Skill Sims can tweak their workouts using Options like "Quick Burst" to increase your skill gain before becoming fatigued.
0xC7EF515D7E83BC90: Sims with a high Athletic Skill are naturally inclined to succeed in the Professional Sports career, located at the stadium. These Sims will excel at Opportunities and quickly rise through the ranks in the career.
0x61D10631574DC7DC: The Base Camp is your Sim's home away from home.This is a place where Sims can take care of all their basic needs.
0x61D10631574DC7DF: Check the Adventure Board located at the Base Camp. Locals will often post exciting Adventures or lucrative business propositions.
0xE5C43EEB17BE4BD3: The Base Camp is your Sim's home away from home. Would you like to learn more?
0x9F85405D5328C5C7: Sims can learn the Charisma Skill by practicing speeches in front of their mirror, taking a class, or reading up on the subject. Very charismatic Sims are wizzes of socializing and can make friends nearly instantly!
0x9F85405D5328C5C4: Powerful "Greeting" social interactions are unlocked as your Sim progresses in the Charisma Skill. These allow Sims to begin any conversation however they please, be it Romantic or Funny! The best way to increase your Sim's Charisma Skill is by socializing with other Sims!
0x9F85405D5328C5C5: Eventually, Sims with the Charisma Skill can use the "Smooth Recovery" social, which allows the Sim to rewind the effects of a poorly delivered social.
0xEB2E7DFACF3863A9: The Cooking Skill allows Sims to make great meals that provide powerful Moodlets. Sims improve their Cooking Skill by preparing meals, reading cook books, or watching the cooking channel on TV.
0xEB2E7DFACF3863AA: Sims learn a wide variety of recipes as they improve their Cooking Skill, including breakfast items, desserts, and incredible evening entrées. Sims get better at cooking a meal the more they do it, so practicing the same meal can lead to mastery over it. Many other recipes can be purchased from the Bookstore.
0xEB2E7DFACF3863AB: High quality recipes that are prepared by expert chefs will lead to powerful, long-lasting Moodlets like "Amazing Meal." These will keep your Sim happy for hours!
0x00D63F10101EF957: There are many different fish species to be found throughout town. You can find the best fishing spots by looking for fish jumping or swimming under the water. You can also use the "Inspect" interaction by clicking on the water to find out what kind of fish that body of water has. Fish will always swim in the same locations.
0x00D63F10101EF954: Knowing the proper bait will greatly improve a Sim's chances of catching a specific fish. You can learn the bait for a fish by experimenting with fruits, vegetables, ingredients, and other fish, or by purchasing bait books from the Bookstore.
0x00D63F10101EF955: Fishing can be a lucrative business venture as well as a great Sim hobby! Sims can earn quite a few Simoleons by catching and selling rare, high-quality fish to the Supermarket.
0x00D63F10101EF952: Larger and heavier fish tend to be worth more. Increase your Fishing Skill and use Perfect bait to catch the best fish!
0xC14DE28CA994DD0C: Fishing can be a quite a lucrative hobby if you know how, and where, to catch the best fish. Would you like to learn more about Fishing?
0x7B2972D7557D72E4: To start a garden, select the "Plant" interaction when clicking on a fruit, vegetable, or seed in your Sim's inventory. This will attach the object to your mouse cursor, which lets you pick the planting location.
0x7B2972D7557D72E7: Sims improve their Gardening Skill by planting and watering plants, or reading gardening books. Developing the skill will allow your Sims to grow rarer produce and use more advanced techniques like "Fertilize" or "Weed."
0x7B2972D7557D72E6: Different objects can be used to fertilize plants with varying degrees of effectiveness. In general, effectiveness is determined by the rarity of the fertilizer. For example, rare fish and plants are better than common ones, whereas some special ingredients are the best.
0x7B2972D7557D72E1: Replanting some of your best produce will continually increase the quality of your garden over generations. If a tomato plant yields at least one Good quality tomato, try replanting it to see if it will grow into a plant that provides even better produce.
0x1860AB11735F3F5B: Not only is gardening a fun and rewarding hobby, but you can grow your own food!. Would you like to learn more about Gardening?
0x8B1DD042826A2C57: Instrument Skills can be obtained by playing an instrument. Sims learn new compositions and abilities as they improve their Instrument Skills.
0x8B1DD042826A2C54: Once you advance in any Instrument Skill, Playing for Tips is a great way for Sims to improve their skill and earn quite a few Simoleons! Place any instrument in your Sim's inventory and send them to a public area to "Play for Tips." If other Sims like what they hear, they'll begin tipping handsomely!
0x8B1DD042826A2C55: Sims eventually learn the "Perform" interaction, which allows you to choose which composition you want them to perform. Many new compositions will be learned when improving the particular Instrument Skill, but others can be purchased from the bookstore. Sims can also "Serenade" their love interests!
0x8B1DD042826A2C52: Master Tracks can be learned by completing Skill Challenges or  mastering an Instrument Skill. The Skill Journal can be used to track overall progress, what compositions have been learned, and information about Skill Challenges.
0xB3B2F1C910BBF564: The Handiness Skill teaches Sims to repair and upgrade household furnishings. Repairing broken items or reading Handiness books are great ways to learn the skill.
0xB3B2F1C910BBF567: Instead of calling the local Repairman to fix broken appliances, Sims with the Handiness Skill can do it themselves. Take caution when working on electronic devices as it may lead to electrocution.
0xB3B2F1C910BBF566: Upgrading can transform low-quality household items into useful workhorses. Showers can be upgraded to never break, stoves can be upgraded to prevent fire, and TVs can be upgraded to deliver new, high quality channels. As your Sims advance in the Handiness Skill they'll learn new upgrades, so pay attention for new opportunities to upgrade.
0xB3B2F1C910BBF561: Completing Handiness Skill Challenges will aid your Sims when tinkering around the house. For example, repairing a certain number of electrical objects will keep your Sim from ever being electrocuted.
0xCD3F0060889ABC2E: Sims with a Level 3 Visa can purchase a Vacation Home by selecting the phone and choosing “Purchase Vacation Home.”
0xCD3F0060889ABC2D: Sims can purchase multiple Vacation Homes at each location! When arriving, select which home you want your Sims to use.
0xCD3F0060889ABC2C: Sims can purchase multiple vacation homes at each location! When arriving, select which home you want your Sims to use.
0xCD3F0060889ABC2B: Vacation homes are a great investment and a good way to store treasures obtained by adventuring!
0x6D546BE824F8AAF3: The Logic Skill can be learned by using a telescope or playing chess. Don’t forget to take advantage of the free chess tables in the park!
0x6D546BE824F8AAF0: The Logic Skill can be learned by Sims at a very young age. Buy toddlers an educational toy like the Peg Box to increase their Logic Skill when they grow older.
0x6D546BE824F8AAF1: The Chess tournament circuit is a great way for Sims to improve their Logic Skill and meet new Sims around the neighborhood. Sims at the top of the circuit also teach others chess more quickly!
0x6D546BE824F8AAF6: Sims who master the Logic Skill are able to tutor other Sims in any skill the tutor has already learned. This means parents can quickly turn their children into incredible artists, chefs, and more!
0xDC8918DC1361BDBC: Foreign locations have markets for Sims to socialize and purchase wares from local merchants. The General Store is a great place to purchase survival gear such as dried food or the ever-useful Shower in a Can.
0xDC8918DC1361BDBF: The local food merchant sells a variety of delicious foods, ingredients, and lets Sims sample new recipes! The book merchant sells local recipes and samplings from local writers.
0xDC8918DC1361BDBE: The Relic Merchant has an interesting stall with a wide variety of valuable (and worthless) goods that change daily. Visit often to find new deals!
0xDC8918DC1361BDB9: There is a special merchant wandering around the market place who sells special goods. This merchant only accepts Ancient Coins, however, and at times only does business with Sims who have a high Visa Level!
0x569A9BCB4A954733: Sim can buy great things from markets across the world! Would you like to learn more?
0x639C7D659886224C: A long-term, successful romance can often lead to marriage between two Sims.
0x639C7D659886224F: Sims can become engaged by successfully “Proposing Marriage.” This social interaction can be found in the “Romantic…” menu. Your Sim may need to woo their potential Fiancé a bit before the option appears!
0x639C7D659886224E: Engaged Sims can set up a Wedding Party via the phone, or hold a private ceremony using the “Hold Private Wedding” social interaction found in the “Romantic…” menu.
0xE61E0B8D35D74FF5: Originating in Shang Simla, practitioners of martial artists train in physical combat to find inner peace and confidence. While generally abhorring conflict, those trained in martial arts are capable fighters who can easily defeat untrained opponents when provoked.
0xE61E0B8D35D74FF6: While some information and learning can occur through the reading of books on the subject, most choose to learn by doing. Martial artists can be found at the Academy or gym testing their skill on training dummies, board breakers, and even each other.
0xE61E0B8D35D74FF7: Martial artists may choose to spar with other practitioners of the skill. Some Sims will even travel all the way to Shang Simla to test their skills competitively. The ranked tournament circuit is home to some of the most skilled martial artists in the world.
0xE61E0B8D35D74FF0: As martial artists develop, they often turn to spiritual meditation in search of inner balance. It is said that highly skilled martial artists can reach such a state of tranquility that they can dispel their worries and are even capable of physically transporting themselves through shear force of will.
0xA25FCF684BCFF192: Becoming a skilled Martial Artists is a rewarding journey. Would you like to learn more?
0x84A5EC02096AD8A8: Making Nectar in a Nectar Maker is the best way to acquire and start building your Nectar Making Skill. If you can't afford one of your own, use the public Nectar Maker in the Nectary.
0x84A5EC02096AD8AB: Different combinations of fruit can be used to make different kinds and qualities of Nectar. Use high quality fruit to make the best Nectars.
0x84A5EC02096AD8AA: Once bottled, Nectar will age naturally. Store your Nectar in a Nectar Rack to increase the speed at which it appreciates in value and quality.
0x00C4472821CDAC27: The best Nectar making Sims in the world are able to make a great living off selling their high quality Nectars. Would you like to learn more about Nectar Making?
0x67EEC175E0A4CC11: The Painting Skill can be learned by buying an easel and begining to paint, or by purchasing the Painting Skill book from the Bookstore. The pieces painted by Sims with the Painting Skill will increase in value as the Sims improve their Painting Skill. Completed paintings will also naturally appreciate over time and become more valuable.
0x67EEC175E0A4CC12: Finished paintings can be placed on the wall with the Hand Tool in Buy Mode or by dragging the canvas with the cursor while in Live Mode.  The quality of the painting will directly affect the room's environment, which means happier Sims!
0x67EEC175E0A4CC13: Sims with a higher Painting Skill level can paint Still Life paintings and eventually, stylized Still Life paintings. These interactions are available on the easel. They allow Sims to paint their surroundings as chosen by the player.
0x67EEC175E0A4CC14: Sims are able to sell finished paintings if you choose. Sims with a low Painting Skill level may not earn many Simoleons per painting, but Master Painters can make a living from their works.
0xFFF4FBEE982D4AF4: You can start learning the Photography Skill once your Sim has a Camera in their inventory.  Cameras can be purchased from a General Goods Merchant.
0xFFF4FBEE982D4AF7: Everyone from Children to Elders can learn Photography.  Just pick up a Camera and start taking photos!
0xFFF4FBEE982D4AF6: In the Photography Skill journal, you will find collections of subjects.  Completing a collection will give you a skill boost. As you gain more Skill, you will be able to take photos in different styles and sizes.  Once you master the Photography skill, you can take photos for free!
0x9E62E89397D4D3EB: Would you like to learn more about the Photography Skill?
0xE8D8D77F8AFF5FA2: The Adventure Tracker is a great tool to assist your Sims when carrying out adventures in foreign lands.
0xE8D8D77F8AFF5FA1: You can read your Sim’s current objective here. In some cases, you can click on it to send your Sim to complete the objective!
0xE8D8D77F8AFF5FA0: Click on the Adventure Journal button to open up the journal.
0xE8D8D77F8AFF5FA7: The Adventure Tracker only appears when your Sim has an Adventure. You can minimize the Adventure Tracker by clicking the arrow.
0xC9AD0C86B0FE0C09: The Adventure Tracker can help you keep your Adventuring goals clear and organized. Would you like to learn more about the Adventure Tracker?
0xB8D02C6B7017B64B: Visit The Sims 3 Store via Shop Mode by clicking on Shop Mode or using F4 in the Main Menu, Create-a-Sim, and Build/Buy.
0xB8D02C6B7017B648: Browse everything for sale on the store.thesims3.com and even more via Shop Mode.  You can manage your account from the left navigation, check your SimPoints, access your billing history and even register your game.
0xB8D02C6B7017B649: You can browse The Sims 3 Store using the left navigation or click on category buttons at the top to jump around.  Click Home any time to return to the homepage.
0xB8D02C6B7017B64E: Where did your stuff go?  Access the Downloads Dashboard from your Options Menu or from Shop Mode to see what is installing and what else you can add to your game.  Just remember, you need to be logged into The Sims 3 Store.
0x1ECF39524D554788: Visit The Sims 3 Store via Shop Mode. Get a brief tour on shopping and a lesson on how to get goodies quickly into your game.
0x689FEEA6FD950EC7: Ancient Relics of incredible rarity and value can be found in the deepest depths of Chinese, French, and Egyptian tombs.
0x689FEEA6FD950EC4: These Relics are one of a kind and are truly precious. Each one is a part of a collection that can be completed. Completed Relic collections provide powerful moodlets to Sims!
0x689FEEA6FD950EC5: Check the Adventure Journal to see what Relics are currently owned and which ones have yet to be found!
0x6CEB5D41D93CFAFC: Relic collecting can be a profitable and rewarding venture! Would you like to learn more?
0xDA19E8FD9D5ABA9C: Dive wells are mysterious pools found in hidden tombs.
0xDA19E8FD9D5ABA9F: Sims on fire can jump into dive wells to put themselves out. Sims can also pre-emptively jump into a dive well to soak themselves in order to pass safely through a fire trap.
0xDA19E8FD9D5ABA9E: Some dive wells will lead to other dive wells, which allows Sims to gain access to previously closed off or hidden areas. Some dive wells may lead to other locations in the world entirely!
0xDA19E8FD9D5ABA99: Dive wells may also contain treasures at the bottom or hidden switches to activate hidden secrets. Be sure to explore them if stuck in a room with no exit!
0x954B76FD12DD7D13: Dive Wells play an important part in successful tomb exploration. Would you like to learn more?
0xD7F96002C5319284: Floor switches are found in most ancient tombs. Sims can stand on them to activate hidden secrets.
0xD7F96002C5319287: Sometimes a floor switch will no longer activate a secret when a Sim steps off of it. When this happens, look for a statue and direct your Sims to push or pull the statue onto the switch!
0xD7F96002C5319286: Keep in mind that some switches will not only activate a secret when stepping onto them, but also when stepping off. Many puzzles may require your Sims to mix and match the states of floor switches in order to advance.
0xD7F96002C5319281: Don't forget that floor switches can be made invisible -- don't be surprised if they appear…or disappear, right before your Sim's eyes!
0x83FF79E089E3DD7B: Floor Switches can be used by Sims to unlock doors and reveal unseen passageways. Would you like to learn more?
0x46686C661FDD86C9: Deadly traps can prevent careless Sims from making it out of a tomb safely. One misstep can lead to a spicy situation! Traps can be hidden or visible on both the floor or the wall.
0x46686C661FDD86CA: Traps can be inspected in order to find out what type of trap they are. Your mouse cursor will change if there is a hidden trap that can be Inspected. Some traps can also be disarmed, which makes them safe to cross!
0x46686C661FDD86CB: They come in four variants: electrical, steam, darts, and fire! Different traps can have unique behavior. For example, Soaked Sims can walk through fire traps, and water from a Steam trap can disarm a Fire trap!
0x46686C661FDD86CC: Floor traps can also be disarmed by pushing a statue on top of them. By using their surroundings and paying attention, Sims can pass by the traps in top shape!
0x9A87CED21DB4558E: Beware of dangerous traps hidden throughout tombs and catacombs! Would you like to learn more?
0xA0378FC6B86E6B10: Giant boulders are immovable inconveniences that prevent Sims from entering special tombs or secret treasure rooms.
0xA0378FC6B86E6B13: These boulders can only be smashed with Pangu's Axe, a mystical tool that can only be found in China.
0xA0378FC6B86E6B12: Complete the Adventure to obtain Pangu's Axe to unlock countless special treasures and unique tombs!
0xD82B2E22F1833BCF: Unfortunately there's no way around Giant Boulders, other than through them. Would you like to learn more?
0x24851CA33700C962: Tombs contain secret passages and hidden crevices to prevent adventuring Sims from discovering lost treasures.
0x24851CA33700C961: Many of these hidden doors can be uncovered when Sims Inspect the walls. Your mouse cursor icon will change if there is a hidden door to be found on the wall.
0x24851CA33700C960: Some hidden doors are locked and can only be opened by finding the proper switch to open the door. Others can be opened by a little sweat and hardwork from Sims. Sims with a higher Athletic Skill will be able to open the doors more quickly!
0x24851CA33700C967: Some walls will remain hidden until Sims find the proper switch to open the door. Explore every nook and cranny of the tomb in order to find all of its treasures!
0xCEE9FEF1E3366349: Tombs are riddled with hidden doors and secret passageways. Would you like to learn more?
0x9F3D37B7B7BF7FE7: Some tombs will have small holes in the wall or floor for brave Sims to stick their arms into.
0x9F3D37B7B7BF7FE4: Some of these holes will contain hidden switches to unlock secrets, or even treasures!
0x9F3D37B7B7BF7FE5: Other holes may lead to deadly bugs that fill Sims with dread!
0x9F3D37B7B7BF7FE2: Keep in mind that holes can appear and disappear when triggered!
0x765E09172888811C: Tomb Holes often contain treasure, and sometimes danger, but they're always worth investigating. Would you like to learn more?
0x6729FC793DBECF8A: Keystones are one of the most vital and commonplace items found in Tombs. They are used to activate Keystone panels and unlock doors, treasure chests, or other hidden secrets.
0x6729FC793DBECF89: Keystones come in four variants: Crescent (Egypt), Heart (France), Star (China), and unique. Keystone Panels will only accept one type of key, so find the right keystones to advance!
0x6729FC793DBECF88: Unique keystones will often be used to gain entrance to special tombs designed for Adventures.
0x6729FC793DBECF8F: Keystones will often be found in Treasure Chests, but also on the ground, at the bottom of Dive Wells, underneath rubble piles, or other places.
0xDF2A453E71183FF1: Keystones can be used to unlock treasure chests, doors, and other secret adventures. Would you like to learn more?
0x19A262CFC0E8711D: Sarcophagi are commonplace in tombs, often the ancient burial places of the ruling class of long-dead civilizations.
0x19A262CFC0E8711E: A sarcophagus may contain treasures, a trigger to unveil hidden secrets, or even a mummy!
0x19A262CFC0E8711F: Mummies should be avoided in tombs! Mummies are incredibly strong and will most likely leave your Sims passed out on the ground. Or worse, your Sims may be cursed. If not taken care of, the curse will eventually end your Sim's life!
0x19A262CFC0E87118: Mummies can be distracted with Mummy Snacks, which can be purchased from the special merchant.
0xF49D57A7010FC1FA: Mummies are quite dangerous beings, but a few easy tricks can protect even the most novice of explorers. Would you like to learn more?
0x6BBEFA7706B0587E: There are statues in tombs that can be pushed or pulled by Sims in order to advance further into the tomb or solve puzzles. By inspecting them, Sims may discover that they can be moved!
0x6BBEFA7706B0587D: Some puzzles may require your Sims to push the statues in such a way to clear a path to a door or floor switch.
0x6BBEFA7706B0587C: Other puzzles may require your Sims to push statues onto floor switches in order to make them permanently activated.
0x6BBEFA7706B0587B: Statues can also be pushed onto floor traps to disarm them, which makes it safe for Sims to cross the traps!
0xE0BCF3689BC959BD: Some statues in tombs can be pushed or pulled to activate hidden secrets. Would you like to learn more?
0xFBF0897CCB5B6434: Rubble piles are pieces of tombs that have fallen into decay over the centuries. Sims can clear them away with just a little bit of effort.
0xFBF0897CCB5B6437: Rubble piles may cover hidden treasures, passageways, or switches needed to progress through tombs.
0xFBF0897CCB5B6436: Sims will improve their Athletic Skill by clearing rubble piles. Also, Sims with a higher Athletic Skill will clear rubble piles more quickly.
0xA04B5928BB65CDAB: Rubble Piles often conceal hidden treasures or passageways. Would you like to learn more?
0xE134A34CE3A1BCCE: Tombs are filled with deadly traps, puzzling challenges, and vast riches for your Sims.
0xE134A34CE3A1BCCD: It pays to be observant in tombs! Move your mouse cursor over walls and the floors to find hidden traps and doors that may spell the difference between doom and riches!
0xE134A34CE3A1BCCC: Some tombs will contain puzzles designed to stump your Sims. Look for clues to find the way forward. Keep in mind there is almost always the hard way, and the right way.
0xE134A34CE3A1BCCB: Don't forget to take the treasure! Tombs are filled with riches and ancient relics for Sims to complete their own private museums.
0x952E9F71FFAB2A8D: Tombs are full of hidden passages, danger, and treasure beyond imagination. Would you like to learn more?
0xA7857FB1E9DFC40B: Sims may uncover a variety of ancient Relics while exploring Egypt, China, and France.
0xA7857FB1E9DFC408: Some Relics are not worth a large amount of Simoleons, but are still reminders of an ancient civilization.
0xA7857FB1E9DFC409: These Relics can be sold for Simoleons, or used to bolster and add breadth to a Sim's private relic collection!
0x5C9AD7C44137A2C8: Common Relics won't get you much in the market, but they're still worth collecting. Would you like to learn more?
0xE8E1D3CF89F1F5A0: Ancient Treasure Chests can be found throughout the ancient tombs and sacred halls of long-dead civilizations in China, France, and Egypt.
0xE8E1D3CF89F1F5A3: Treasure Chests contain riches, Adventure Rewards, keystones, and even survival gear like Dried Food.
0xE8E1D3CF89F1F5A2: Treasure Chests might also trigger special events in tombs to help your Sims on their adventures.
0xE8E1D3CF89F1F5A5: Be careful to observe the clues in the tomb, as some Treasure Chests may prove to be dangerous distractions!
0x986331B34ADBBEDF: Treasure Chests provide Sims with more than just riches. Would you like to learn more?
0x761679181C62866C: When in their home world, Sims can use their cell phone, home phone, or computer to "Travel To" a new location.
0x761679181C62866F: In the Trip Planner, you can select where you want to travel to and with whom. However, certain attributes like your amount of family funds and your Sims' Visa levels will affect where and for how long you are able to travel.
0x761679181C62866E: Once confirmed, a taxi will come and whisk your Sim, or your Sim and their party off to a foreign land.
0x761679181C628669: If, when arriving at your destination, a Sim in your party owns a vacation home, you will be prompted to select where you would like your Sims to arrive. If no vacation home is owned by your party, your Sim(s) will automatically arrive at the Base Camp.
0x13D90BC14B3EDDCB: Sims can go on exotic adventures and solve exciting mysteries while traveling the world. Would you like to learn more about Traveling?
0x9B580134C3F3C5D5: Every travel destination has a unique Visa for your Sims to improve.
0x9B580134C3F3C5D6: Sims can improve their Visa Level by completing Adventures, which can be begun at the Adventure Board located in the Base Camp of each destination.
0x9B580134C3F3C5D7: A higher Visa Level grants Sims special privileges in the destination corresponding to the Visa. For example, a Level 3 Visa in China lets Sims plan longer vacations, undertake more challenging Adventures, and even purchase a vacation home in China!
0x9B580134C3F3C5D0: Sims can also use their Visas to purchase better rewards from the Merchant wandering around the market place!
0x071E1139542FFA72: Visas allow Sims to travel to different lands and can grant them different privileges while they're there. Would you like to learn more?
0x3E74524008E8DDED: Sims can learn the Writing Skill by writing a novel on their computer or the ones found in the local library. Sims can also read about Writing or take a class if you want!
0x3E74524008E8DDEE: Sims can learn to write a wide variety of novel genres as they improve their Writing Skill. Humor, Science Fiction, and Trashy are just three of the genres!
0x3E74524008E8DDEF: Some genres can only be learned by your Sim if they meet the requirements. For example, only Elders can write historical novels and Sims who want to write Fantasy books should practice writing Science Fiction first.
0x3E74524008E8DDE8: Sims earn weekly royalty checks in the mail when they complete a novel. The size of the check is determined by the quality of the book. Sims with a higher Writing Skill and experience in certain genres will earn a lot of money from their hobby!
0xF093B83E1FAAC987: Longer vacations can now be enjoyed abroad and new rewards can be purchased from the special merchant. Check the Adventure Journal for more details!

0xEC9538E0BB218C3F: High Rise living gives Sims the opportunity to live the City lifestyle in large buildings with many other Sims. You can move your Sims onto lots with High Rise buildings just like standard lots, or you can place a High Rise building lot from the Library into your current world as well.
0xEC9538E0BB218C3C: Depending on where your Sims live, you may see other Sims' front doors off the lobby or in hallways of your building. You won't be able to access their private residences, but feel free to give the door a knock to meet and socialize with your fellow High Rise residents in public spaces.
0xEC9538E0BB218C3D: Due to building codes in High Rise buildings, you cannot build or modify any structural elements like walls or windows outside of your living space. Inside of your home, you're permitted to Build and Buy as you would on a normal lot.
0xEC9538E0BB218C3A: When visiting Sims in other High Rise buildings, you can use the Callbox found inside the lobby to call other Sims and ask them to meet you outside of the elevator. They may even invite you up.
0xEC9538E0BB218C3B: Sims living in High Rise buildings also have access to Trash Chutes and Wall Mailboxes. These new objects take the place of garbage cans and mailboxes found on standard lots.
0xF41FC6C7DF642414: Your Sims are now living in a High Rise building! \\n\\nDo you want to learn more about High Rise living?
0xFB74110AF03C7F17: Bands can only receive Gig Offers from venues that meet certain requirements. To create a venue suitable for Gigs, select "Edit Town" from the Options Menu. Create a new Community Lot or Change the Lot Type of an existing lot to be a Dive Bar, Fusion Lounge, Vampire Lounge, Exclusive Lounge, Sports Bar, or Local Watering Hole.
0xFB74110AF03C7F14: Enter Build/Buy Mode on the lot that you want to be able to offer Gigs. Create a building and add a Professional Bar Dive Edition or The Duke Professional Juice Bar from the Surfaces category in Buy Mode.
0xFB74110AF03C7F15: Set up the stage for the band by placing one of each instrument type on the lot: a piano, a guitar, a bass, and a drum kit. While not required, you can keep the venue tidy by placing the instruments on a Platform using Build Mode.
0x864FE97234AFD0E8: The best way for a Sim to learn the Mixology Skill is to purchase a Bar from the Buy Catalog and “Practice” making drinks. Sims without a Bar to practice on can read up on the assorted Mixology Skill books, or even take an official Mixology Class down at a local restaurant. Cheers!
0x864FE97234AFD0EB: To increase your Sim's Mixology Skill, continue practicing and making as many drinks as possible. Your Sim can even “Practice Making Drinks With…” a friend! 0x864FE97234AFD0EA: Sims at the higher levels of the Mixology Skill are able to make different kinds of “Mood Drinks.” When served to Sims, Mood Drinks will affect the Moodlets of Sims in different ways, depending on the drink type and the drinking Sim’s personality. Sims at the highest levels of the skill can even name a drink after a certain Sim!
0x864FE97234AFD0ED: Talented Mixologists have the ability to work at bars and clubs throughout town to increase their skill and earn some extra Simoleons. Only the best beverage mixers can tend bar at some of the high-end establishments, so make sure your Sims know what they are doing or else they will never make it past the bouncer!

0x4C0BBF1A0C3D89CD: To hire a Butler, pick up a phone and "Call for Services." When you hire a Butler, they will live with your Sims, so make sure you have an extra bed for them to sleep on! You can choose a bed for the Butler by selecting a bed and setting it as the Butler’s bed.
0x4C0BBF1A0C3D89CC: Be sure to maintain a good relationship with your butler or they may quit on you!

0x7C872C53928839FB: To become a Celebrity, your Sim must gain Celebrity Points, which increase your Sim's Celebrity Level. Your Sims can obtain Celebrity Points by performing a number of different tasks, such as befriending Celebrities, increasing the relationship level with their Celebrity friends and performing unique Celebrity opportunities.
0x7C872C53928839F8: You can check your Sim's Celebrity progress by going to the Sim's Simology page and opening up the Celebrity Journal. Each time your Sim gains Celebrity Points, the progress bar fills a little. Once the progress bar is filled completely, your Sim will reach the next Celebrity Star Level.
0x7C872C53928839F9: As your Sim increases in Celebrity Star Level, they will begin to unlock the benefits of being a Celebrity. Sims around town will begin to take notice and react differently to your Sim. You may see other Sims come up to them for an autograph or even take a picture. You may also have Paparazzis following your Sim wherever they go.
0x7C872C53928839FE: Celebrities occasionally receive free gifts from businesses throughout town. They can also get discounts on purchases at venues. Sometimes, business owners like a Celebrity so much that they won't charge them anything!
0x7C872C53928839FF: Life as a Celebrity is not always glamorous. Once your Sim starts to become famous, any inappropriate  actions they take are scrutinized by the public. If your Sim is caught misbehaving, they will get the "Publicly Disgraced" moodlet that will make them the talk of town. A "Publicly Disgraced" Sim has a harder time getting into clubs and no longer receives any discounts or freebies. The public will react negatively to them and they have a harder time impressing other Celebrities.
0x7C872C53928839FC: Not all is lost for Publically Disgraced Sims! You can remove this moodlet by paying a hefty sum to the Paparazzi. Another option is to go to the Business building to "Deflect Scandal" and push the moodlet to another Sim Celebrity. You can also go to City Hall and "Sue For Slander" in an attempt to clear your name. Lastly, you can just talk to other Sims and try to dispel the scandal as a rumor.
0x11CE3A35D8C09AB8: Your Sim has gained a Celebrity Point! There are many different ways to earn Celebrity Points.\\n\\nWould you like to learn more?
0x52DA8AC7764D25A5: Celebrity Sims are models of fame and fortune. Getting them to become friends with your Sim is not going to be easy! Unlike normal Sims, Celebrities must first be impressed by your Sim's achievements before your Sim can befriend them.
0x52DA8AC7764D25A6: There are a number of ways to get Celebrities to notice your Sim. Start off by talking about a skill that your Sim has acquired or about their career.
0x52DA8AC7764D25A7: Another way to get Celebrities to acknowledge your Sim is by name dropping another Celebrity that your Sim knows.
0x52DA8AC7764D25A0: If all else fails, flaunt your Sim's wealth to impress that reluctant Celebrity!
0xF06F6A7AE296D242: Before Celebrities will acknowledge your Sim, they must first be impressed by your Sim's personal success.\\n\\nWould you like to learn more?

0xF1617F3689AB48C8: Land comes at a premium in a bustling city. With new high-rise buildings come new business opportunities! To help designate these new locations, you'll notice combined icons in Map View that show all the functions a building provides.
0xF1617F3689AB48CB: All government services can now be found within the storied walls of City Hall. In a single building, you'll have access to your local politicians, the police department, and any military functions.
0xF1617F3689AB48CA: There's one easy stop downtown to enrich your Sim's mind or relax their body. You'll find an opulent bookstore along with a rejuvenating spa located within the lower mezzanine of this high-rise.
0xF1617F3689AB48CD: Set along a beautiful coastal vista, this building is now home to the city's champions of commerce, along with one of the most elegant dining experiences around. Visit here to satisfy your business aspirations or enjoy a taste of the finer things in life.

0x853ECF5C01971505: To use an Elevator in Live Mode, click on the Elevator Doors on your Sim's current floor. 0x853ECF5C01971506: You can place and use Elevators on all lots. When you place Elevator Doors from the Build Catalog, the doors of the Elevator must be placed on a wall.
0x853ECF5C01971507: To travel between floors, Elevator Shafts must line up correctly to create a continuous elevator path between each floor. Elevator Shafts without doors can be placed on a floor that you do not want Sims to be able to go.

0x853ECF5C01971501: When placing elevators in High Rises, you do not need to place Elevator Shafts on floors that you do not have access to. However, you must still make sure any Elevators on the lobby floor line up with any Elevators on your floor.

0x8C269164F1CC7FB9: It’s more fun if friends hang out together as a group! Invite other Sims to spend time with your Sim by using the "Form Group" social. Your Sim can also use the phone to "Invite Over" or "Invite Out" other Sims. There may be up to eight Sims in a group at a time.
0x8C269164F1CC7FBA: Sims in a group will stick together when traveling to bars and other venues. Group members will follow your Sim when they travel to other locations. Look for special group interactions on certain buildings, such as the Theater, Stadium, or Day Spa.
0x8C269164F1CC7FBB: If you want to remove a Sim from the group, direct your Sim to use the "Ask to Leave" social on the Sim you want to leave.
0x8C269164F1CC7FBC: If you want your Sim to leave the group, use the "Quit Group" interaction to remove only that Sim. Or use "Disband Group" to end the group immediately.
0xE826D9D5B6459E7E: Your Sim has just entered a group. There are different social interactions available when your Sim group with other Sims.\\n\\nWould you like to learn more?
0x2DE054CB32FC2C3F: Jam on any instrument to build your Sim’s musical skills. Once you’ve practiced enough on any musical instrument to earn a skill point, your Sim is ready to start a band!
0x2DE054CB32FC2C3C: Start a band by finding another musically inclined Sim and Ask them to Form a Band with your Sim. Up to four Sims may be in a band at a time. To remove a Sim from the band, select that Sim and use the "Kick Out" interaction.

0x2DE054CB32FC2C3A: During a Gig, you can change the type of music played by the band by switching Genres. 0x2DE054CB32FC2C3B: The Band tab of the Skill Journal tracks information about your Sim's band, such as the total number of Gigs played, the total amount of Simoleons earned, and any name changes the band goes through.
0x2DE054CB32FC2C38: Bands will automatically be eligible for Gig offers in Bridgeport. For more information on creating band venues in other neighborhoods, see the lesson on "Building Band Venues."
0xFCF6BA59BF5DC414: Bands are a great way for Sims to play music together and perhaps even gain fame and fortune! \n\nWould you like to learn more about Bands?
0xBE05D3FD41DFD6DE: Vampires must care for a Thirst Need instead of Hunger. Vampires can satisfy their Thirst by consuming Plasma Pack Quick Snacks from the Fridge, eating Plasma Fruits, or Drinking from Sims with whom your Vampire Sims have a good relationship.

0xBE05D3FD41DFD6DA: Vampires can turn other Sims into a Vampire by “Offering to Turn” them. Likewise, if your Sim hopes to become a vampire, it’s best to befriend a vampire in town and “Ask to be Turned.”

0x2373E8D88D881872: The Barrier Rope is used to restrict which Sims are allowed into certain rooms or an entire venue. The Barrier Rope is in the Community Objects in Build Mode and can only be placed against a door or arch.
0x2373E8D88D881871: When placed on a community lot, the barrier rope summons a Bouncer who protects against Sims attempting to trespass in the room. To set up the rope permissions, enter Build Mode and hold down Shift and Ctrl, then left-click on the barrier rope.
0x2373E8D88D881870: The Set Access Level option sets what types of Sims are allowed to pass the barrier rope. If you select "Everyone," all Sims can pass. The "No One" option prevents all Sims from passing the barrier rope regardless of the other options you set, such as "Celebrity Level" or "Bribe Amount." To customize the access restriction on the barrier rope, select "Limited."
0x2373E8D88D881877: The "Set Celebrity Level" option sets what level of celebrities (between 0 and 5) are allowed access through the barrier rope. Sims with a lower Celebrity status than the set level cannot pass through the rope. The "Set Occults" option lets you set which occults have access. The "Set Bribe Amount" option sets the amount of Simoleons required for a Sim to successfully bribe the Bouncer.
0x2373E8D88D881876: Once you set up the permissions the way you want, you can build your own custom community lots to fit your need. If you place a barrier rope on a residential lot, a Bouncer will not be assigned to the barrier rope and all Sims will have access through the barrier rope.
0x11F5CEBA4B8596D9: Barrier Ropes are a powerful tool for keeping unwanted Sims out of certain rooms or an entire venue.\\n\\nWould you like to learn how to set these restrictions?
0x3BF0F91BF2B9C0BF: The World Editor tool allows you to place new lots, trees, rocks, and landmarks in your world.\\n\\nWould you like to learn more on how to place them?
0xD14A57BC98CEC685: You now have the ability to place new lots and decorate your world with the World Editor tool. You can find the tool in Edit Town.
0xD14A57BC98CEC686: In this mode you can see that there are four tabs on the top that will allow you to place down lots, trees, rocks, and landmarks.
0xD14A57BC98CEC687: There are many different sizes of lots you can choose from. Start by selecting the lot you desire and place it over an open area in the world. You can rotate the lot in the increments of 45 degrees by holding down the left mouse button before placing the lot in the world. You can also do smaller increments if you also hold down the Alt key.
0xD14A57BC98CEC680: Trees, rocks, and landmarks are all decorations that you can place in your world. The only restriction is that you cannot place them on lots or roads. Lots have the same restrictions as decorations except they also cannot be placed on un-routable terrain.
0xD14A57BC98CEC681: If you want to edit decorations that are already placed in the world you can just pick them up from the world and drag it to the trash can or press the delete key to delete.

0x1607AF412180F375: Sims can age up while they are away at school. When this happens, your Sim will get their final marks from their school. 0xD80D4D22FD19D81D: Sims can create a variety of potions and increase their Logic skill using the Catalyst Chemistry Lab Station. Your Sim can research formulas for new potions using Discover Potion. Sims can then Make that Potion whenever they like using the Lab Station. Anytime a Sim makes or discovers a potion, it can be found in the Sim's inventory.

0x3290235B3A792B4F: Nurturing or Family-Oriented Sims should check out the new Daycare profession, which allows them to care for the neighborhood's bundles of joy. This profession can be found on the newspaper or computer.

0x7571390DDDAD38E5: You now have the option to share your Sims' Memories with your friends and family outside of The Sims 3. You can upload a memory to either The Sims 3 website or Facebook. To upload or share Memories, you must first have a registered account at www.thesims3.com.
0x7571390DDDAD38E6: On the Memory Detail page, you can share a Memory on The Sims 3 website by clicking the Upload to sims3.com button. Then, you will need to log into The Sims 3 website and the memory will appear on the "My Page" > "My Studio" > "Memories" tab of your Sims 3 account.
0x7571390DDDAD38E7: The Share to Facebook option is also located on the Memory Detail page. The first time you select this option, you will be prompted to log into The Sims 3 website and then into Facebook. The next time you share a Memory with that account, you will not be asked to log into Facebook.
0x7571390DDDAD38E0: You can disassociate your Facebook account from your Sims 3 account by going into the Game Options and selecting the "Unlink Facebook" button. You can also unlink the two accounts by logging into Facebook and deleting The Sims 3 application.

0xD049A33EE422C355: Sometimes when Sims transition into adulthood, they aren't ready to face the responsibility of adulthood and become anxious to recapture their youth!  \\n\\nDo you want to learn more about the Midlife Crisis?
0x7C6A1117545EB3C9: Faced with the responsibility of becoming an Adult, your Sim may enter a Midlife Crisis on their birthday. While your Sim is going through a Midlife Crisis, they can complete special wishes that help them cling to their youth and earn extra Lifetime Happiness points as they enter the later stages of life.
0x7C6A1117545EB3CA: Unlike normal wishes, once a Midlife Crisis wish is promised to a Sim, it cannot be canceled. These wishes will last until they are fulfilled or the Midlife Crisis ends. When a Sim has promised a Midlife Crisis wish, they will take a negative mood hit until it is completed.
0x7C6A1117545EB3CB: If a Sim successfully completes their crisis, they will be rewarded with bonus Lifetime Happiness points and a positive moodlet based upon how many Midlife Crisis wishes they completed.
0x7C6A1117545EB3CC: There is no penalty for avoiding the Midlife Crisis wishes if you choose not to promise them to your Sim. Alternatively, if the pressure of going over the hill gets to be too much, you may send your Sim to the local hospital to get therapy and end their crisis early.

0x7304DAB8AFBBE7B2: Babies! It's always a joyous occasion when a momma pet gives birth to a cute critter. Be it a tiny kitten, a cuddly puppy, or a wobbly legged foal, these innocent animals need special care to grow up into healthy pets.
0x7304DAB8AFBBE7B1: Baby kittens need lots of attention to become healthy and socially adjusted cats. Play with them, love them, provide them with lots of food and toys, and you'll discover the cutest companion a Sim can have.
0x7304DAB8AFBBE7B0: Before they can become man's best friend, puppies need a Sim to look out for them, teach them, and guide them as they grow up. Give your puppy a lot of special attention and healthy food so they grow strong! Don't forget to help them up and down stairs when they're too small to make it on their own.
0x7304DAB8AFBBE7B7: A young foal is already a pretty big pet, but don't be fooled - they need as much care as anyone to become a well raised horse. Foals are very social creatures and don't like being alone. Keep them together with their mother, be it in the same box stall or out roaming around with each other. Make sure to let them nurse from their mom, or feed them from a bottle to ensure they get the nutrients they need.
0xB80B2C15664B5599: Kittens, puppies, and foals - oh my! There's a fuzzy little bundle of love that just joined the family, would you like to find out the best ways to take care of your youngest pet?
0x0667311937CDCC74: Birds make for excellent companions, with lives that last nearly as long as any Sim. They love to talk, play, or even play tricks! As a low-maintenance pet, they're just the thing for a Sim that can't take on the full responsibility of pet ownership.
0x0667311937CDCC77: Simply owning a bird cage or tree will allow you to purchase certain types of birds, but to acquire the rare and highly sought after ones, you'll have to explore and find them in the world.
0x0667311937CDCC76: Birds need to be fed and their cages cleaned as part of their routine care. If you own a cat, make sure to keep a close eye on them or your bird may find themselves to be a feline's tasty treat.
0x0667311937CDCC71: Taking a stroll around town with a bird on your shoulder can be quite the conversation starter. Of course if you have a large bird, perhaps they'll be the ones to start the conversation! Teach your large bird to talk and you'll never need to leave home to get your social companionship. Be careful though, birds don't know the meaning of "shut up".
0x0667311937CDCC70: Give your large bird the freedom to spread their wings! If you open the door to their cage, or let them perch on a bird tree, they'll occasionally fly around the house. Place a tree in different spots of your home and they'll fly from perch to perch!
0x4939933A859EF96B: It looks like you've taken the first step towards making a feathered friend! Would you like to learn a bit more about bird care, along with the ways they can enrich your Sim's life?
0xA3C0C672ED5EC608: When a mommy pet loves a daddy pet very much they’ll want to start a family!
0xA3C0C672ED5EC60B: Cats and Dogs can Try for Kittens/Puppies if they have a high enough relationship and are romantically inclined. Make sure you have a pet house on your lot so they have somewhere they can go and have some privacy.
0xA3C0C672ED5EC60A: Horses can Try for Foal if you have a box stall on your lot! You can also take your Horse to the Equestrian Center where you can Breed Mares and Offer Stallions as Studs!
0xFA428663BEDE9897: Cats are natural born hunters! Practice Hunting on cat toys found in the Pet Toy Crate to build your cat’s hunting skill.
0xFA428663BEDE9894: Cats can catch a variety of animals – Beetles, Birds, Lizards, Rodents, Snakes, and Turtles. In order to locate these critters in the world, use the Locate Prey interaction in the Hunting Menu available after building up enough Hunting Skill points. This will take you into Map View and show a map tag of where to find prey of that type. Cats can also Stalk for Prey anywhere they are outside. Just select the ground and give it a try.
0xFA428663BEDE9895: Sims can instruct their feline friends to catch prey by asking them to Go Catch Something, or Go Catch A Specific Animal. Though they try their best, there is always the chance the cat might not understand and will bring back something completely different.
0xFA428663BEDE9892: Once a Cat finds a suitable critter to pounce, they stalk and then get into a fight with it! If the cat wins, the critter can be found in their inventory. Animals that cats catch can be kept by Sims as pets in the appropriate terrarium.
0xFA428663BEDE9893: Cats can also Hunt fish with the Go Fish interaction on ponds and oceans.

0x053D7A065936AAA7: There are four important things you need to know about Pet Coat Advanced Mode: Layers, Regions, Markings, and Fur Shapes.
0x053D7A065936AAA4: Start off with the Layers panel, the first tab on the right side. Layers will let you customize your pets' coats in an incremental way. You can add, copy, and remove layers until you get the coat color you desire.
0x053D7A065936AAA5: To help organize your layers, you can name, change the color, and move the layers up and down by selecting different points of the layer. Moving the layers will require some dragging, but it's a simple step in getting the right coat.
0x053D7A065936AAA2: The Regions sections are broken up into several areas of each pet. These areas can be seen on the Pet Mini Map on the upper left. Under each area you can select pre-made designs. Once selected it will appear in your layers panel and on your dog. If you wish to add several regions make sure to add a new layer.
0x053D7A065936AAA3: Next to the Regions Tab, there's a tab called Markings. If you can't find a region design that you want, you can create your own in Markings. Select a markings design and it will apear on the Mini Map rug and selected layer. Here you can size, rotate, and move the design on your pet.
0x053D7A065936AAA0: Once Layers have been completed, select the Fur Shapes Tab next to the Layers Tab. Here you can modify existing fur shapes by mixing and matching breed sliders to create your designed shape.
0x053D7A065936AAA1: If you have created a Coat Color that you want to save, you can select the last tab next to Fur Shape and save your custom color there. Once saved you will see a thumbnail of your newly created coat color. To exit Advanced Mode select the bottom left hand corner.
0x5FE6C5B841FF2C5C: Ready to take Coat Customization to another level eh? Would you like to learn more about how to use the Pet Coat Advanced Mode?
0x6F47F08FC634FCB3: Before your cat or dog arrives, make sure you have the essentials to keep your pet happy. Cats and dogs will need pet bowls, beds, or splurge on a pet house if your wallet can afford it. In Buy Mode under the Kid's Room you will find Pet Essentials. Additional Pet objects are available in the Pets sort under Sort by Function.
0x6F47F08FC634FCB0: If your cat or dog starts to get squirmish, make sure you take them outside. They may need to potty! Cats can potty indoors if you purchase a litter box.
0x6F47F08FC634FCB1: New cats and dogs need attention, so make sure you socialize with them and maybe teach them a trick or two. They can also become destructive at times, so reward them with a toy to keep them happy and having fun.
0x6F47F08FC634FCB6: If you fail to take care of your new cat or dog, the social worker will be back to take your pet away. So make sure to tend to the needs of your pet and develop a relationship with them.

0x8B287F5E0FE66079: Sims can train Dogs to learn the Hunting Skill by selecting the Train to Hunt interaction. Make sure to include some play time in between training sessions as dogs can quickly become fatigued while being trained.
0x8B287F5E0FE6607A: Dogs with the Hunting Skill can use the Dig Up interaction on Dig Spots located throughout the world. The higher the Hunting Skill the dog has, the higher chance they’ll find rare collectibles like Rocks, Gems, Metals, or even fragments of skeletons and sculptures!
0x8B287F5E0FE6607B: Dogs can find Dig Spots throughout the world by using the Locate Collectible… Interaction (or Go Find a Collectible interaction if your Sim is selected). If there are any, you’ll be taken into Map View and special Map Tags will pinpoint the location of the current Dig Spots.
0x8B287F5E0FE6607C: Sims can command their Dogs that have the Hunting Skill to Fetch a Date for them on community lots that have at least one other single Sim of your Sim’s gender preference on it!
0x8B287F5E0FE6607D: All of your Dog’s Hunting Skill stats and skill achievements are tracked and can be referenced in the Hunting Skill Journal.
0xF2D1377400460DBE: Dogs can learn to sniff out rare collectibles, and even a date for your Sim with the Hunting Skill! \\n\\nWould you like to learn more?
0xE564C8F659E70DC8: If you're a prospective horse owner, a verified horse breeder, or an expert rider looking to earn some cold hard simoleons, the Equestrian Center is where you want to be.
0xE564C8F659E70DCB: Looking to jump into the world of horse ownership? Check out the horses for sale! Each one comes with a unique look and special traits. If you don't see one to your liking then check back soon, they get new horses all the time! The better the horse, the more you'll have to pay. Of course this can work to your advantage as well... If you've got a top notch horse to offer, you can make big bucks selling it here.
0xE564C8F659E70DCA: So now you have a horse and you're wondering what to do with it. How about some competitions! Start off by attending a riding class to learn all about the Riding Skill. As you advance and your horse trains their Jumping and Racing Skills, more competitions will open up at the Equestrian Center. These competitions are a great way to see just how well horse and rider have bonded, as well as making a little money on the side. Alternatively, just come watch a competition with friends and family for a fun social outing!
0xE564C8F659E70DCD: Keep your eye on the prize! Winning competitions is all about setting the right pace to gallop your way to victory, fame, and fortunes! A spot on the podium means you'll go home with a beautiful trophy to proudly display, and if you check the local newspaper you may just find yourself on the front page!
0xE564C8F659E70DCC: Your horse had a good run but it's getting a little long in the tooth. That's understandable, competitive careers can't last forever. However, you can ensure future success by breeding a world-class line of equines! If you own a stallion, trainers from far and wide will pay you handsomly to have a chance at using him as a stud. Alternatively, mares can select from prospective partners with ideal traits to breed a strong bloodline.
0x957ED8972EADE3C7: Welcome to the local Equestrian Center pardner! From competitions to breeding, it's the first stop you'll want to make if you're into horses. Would you like to find out more?

0x6B4DF3B27C13AB29: Following body regions you can enter Face regions on the lower right hand corner. Here it will let you customize speciific areas of your pets face by simply selecting the region you're most interested in on the Mini Map or by selecting a region directly on your pet.

0x046E72498A775257: Aargh, fleas! These annoying pests are originally contracted by pets who spend an extended period of time outdoors. They make your skin itch and totally kill your mood.
0x046E72498A775254: If you spot a pet with fleas you'll want to avoid them - coming in contact means there's a chance the fleas could spread to you!
0x046E72498A775255: Fleas can be cured with a rigorous bath for pets, or a hot shower for Sims. Be sure to scrub thoroughly to ensure those critters are gone!
0x046E72498A775252: After a soothing flea bath, your pet can roam outdoors worry free for a period of time. The medicine is still at work and will help protect you from contracting fleas again while it lasts. A quick spray from the Pet Hygienator is also a great way to stay flea free!

0x279DA11A1437D238: Horses are fine creatures but need a lot of care. Before your new horse arrives make sure you have a box stall, water trough, and enough hay to survive.
0x279DA11A1437D23B: Your new pet may need some companionship. Make sure you spend time with your pet and socialize with them. Horses especially enjoy running and jumping.
0x279DA11A1437D23A: If you fail to take care of your new horse, the social worker will be back to take your pet away. So make sure to tend to the needs of your pet and develop a relationship with them.

0x9D388CC3C1476AED: The Jumping Skill is a horse only skill that makes it more likely for the horse to successfully clear jumps. It also increases a horse's performance in certain Equestrian Center competitions.

Horses can also gain jumping skill by competing in Jumping or Cross-Country competitions in the Equestrian Center.
0x9D388CC3C1476AEF: Sims can also help horses gain jumping skill by training along with them. The higher the Sim's Riding Skill the faster the horse increases their Jumping Skill.

0x6CF65AD26CC78FD8: Linking two or more jump obstacles together allows horses and their riders to go through multiple jump obstacles without stopping. In order to achieve this, jump obstacles must be linked together at the ends of one another.
0x6CF65AD26CC78FDB: First, place a jump obstacle in the direction you want horses to jump over. Next, grab another jump obstacle with the mouse cursor. Now, the jump obstacle that's already on your lot will show the available placement areas where you can link the object to.
0x6CF65AD26CC78FDA: By dragging the second jump obstacle to that placement area, the system will automatically link the two obstacles together. At this point, just simply put your jump obstacle down. Once you are all setup, have your Sim get on a horse and perform the Run Jumping Course interaction on any of the linked jump obstacles.

0xBF749C59E12762E7: While common Minor Pets can simply be purchased, those that are rarer must be caught out in the wild.  These little critters require just as much care and attention as other pets, so make sure to feed them and clean their terrariums!!
0xBF749C59E12762E4: Minor Pets also enjoy attention as much as other pets do!  Whether this means spending some time playing with your pet, or even watching it do its own thing within a terrarium, it all contributes to keeping your little critters happy.  Just be sure not to keep them in your inventory for too long, as they can escape!
0xBF749C59E12762E5: If you ever feel that your Minor Pets just aren't getting the attention they deserve anymore, you can always set them free.  Letting them return to their natural habitat is always better than neglecting them.  After all, being ignored enough while trapped in a terrarium can't possibly contribute to a long and healthy life.

0x1F50D3BC507889E9: Sims can also help horses gain racing skill by training along with them. The higher the Sim's Riding Skill the faster the horse increases their Racing Skill.

0x87ECF317A5D25656: Pets behave in many different ways that certain Sims may or may not approve of.  Through reinforcement, you can shape the behavior of your pets over time.
0x87ECF317A5D25655: Certain actions that your pets perform can be reinforced through praise.  In doing so, your pet will begin to learn that its behavior is acceptable.  If behavior that is related to a specific trait is praised enough, your pet will eventually be trained to adopt that trait.
0x87ECF317A5D25654: Any actions that your pet can be praised for can also be subject to a good scolding.  If you feel that your pet's behavior is unacceptable, scolding can make your pet acknowledge that it is behaving badly.  Eventually, your pet may even learn to rid itself of certain traits that encourage its bad behavior.
0x501C653CA772E735: Pets can be trained to adopt different traits depending on their behavior.\\n\\nWould you like to learn more about Reinforceable Behavior?
0x252B860F24D8387A: The Riding Skill encompasses both a Sim’s ability to ride horses and to train them. Its purpose is to reward horse lovers for their devotion to their equine friends. As the Riding Skill improves, new interactions appear for Sims.
0x252B860F24D83879: There are a few ways to gain Riding Skill. You can start off by reading Riding books which can be purchased from your local bookstore, or you can also attend riding classes at the Equestrian Center.
0x252B860F24D83878: If your Sim is more of a hands on type of Sim, you can immediately learn riding by getting on your horse and begin riding around town. Other interactions like Train for Jumps or Train for Racing also increase Riding Skill.

0x4649CDC3278213B1: Riding a horse is a great new way to travel, but unlike Sims they cannot travel everywhere. Horses are not able to walk up or down stairs, use the elevators, or walk through doors. If a Sim riding a horse is commanded to go to a location that they cannot travel to, the horse will route to the furthest location they possibly can and the Sims will dismount and continue towards the destination.
0x4649CDC3278213B2: When Sims are riding a horse, there are certain interactions they can perform without the need to dismount. Interactions with a horse or Sim icon in the interaction menu denotes that Sims will stay mounted and perform that interaction. Any interaction that does not have the horse or Sim icon will push the Sim to dismount the horse before performing that interaction.
0x4649CDC3278213B3: Not all horses are willing to listen to their masters from the get go. Horses who have the Untrained trait require a higher relationship with Sims before they will allow them to saddle or ride them. The more time the Sims spend riding or saddling the horse the faster the horse becomes trained.

0xB78D5C314DB9BBF1: The Racing Training Posts allow players to create their own race training courses for their horses to learn and practice racing. With time and dedication, horses will be able to get better and improve their racing skill.
0xB78D5C314DB9BBF2: While unmounted horses can begin practicing using the training post from the get-go, Sims must have a Riding Skill of 2 or above before they are ready to practice with their horse.
0xB78D5C314DB9BBF3: Be careful though, if a horse trains for too long they can be the victim of training fatigue! This will prevent the horse from training until they are no longer fatigued.

0x32A17D55A891D86B: Turn insufficient accommodations into an Adventure in Sharing with this classy set of bunk beds. 0x617710BB2386D35C: We know, it’s hard to come across an antique canopy bed at this price that isn’t haunted. There’s just something about antique canopy beds! Earl personally researches each and every antique before purchase so he can make the Earl Guarantee: it’s never been haunted! Pick one up today and rest easy.
0x04E05583127483F0: Your bedroom is your sanctuary. No space should feel more intimate. For the Sim who demands luxury, we present the Majestic Rest. Every component is carved, assembled, and finished by hand, and even the tiniest detail gets our full attention. That’s why it takes two years to produce each bed! The Majestic Rest: you’ll want to sleep in it… eternally!
0x155FD75311F7C82D: Intricate and intense, the Darkwood Swallow is the king of EvrSleep’s line of luxury single beds. Its unique design will engulf you in a deep slumber – what could be more relaxing? Fall into the Darkwood Swallow and get swallowed up by a good night’s rest!
0xFF701CBCAE083C64: This classy bed doesn’t have a lower bed like its bunk bed mate, but it still has all the Adventure in Sharing – just without the sharing.
