And the patented QuikClimb Ladder is still there to make getting into bed fast and adventurous.
0xD7FC1A12020F1920: Knowledge is dangerous, and the only reliable way to contain it is with a Permalibro enchanted bookcase. No matter how good, evil or unbreakably-cursed your tome, the Permalibro will keep it subdued and silent, guaranteed! No book is too scary! (Not compatible with tween romance novels.)
0x81FBB3EC11308BF9: When showing your fine tomes to impress the world it’s important to remember that the bookcase is just as important as the books on display. For those times where just any old bookcase won’t do, the Distinguished Bookcase does the job with a class and elegance that’s missing from lesser bookcases. Your books deserve the best. They deserve the Distinguished Bookcase.
0xDDBDFA4096B17D4C: Sleek. Swift. Exquisite. You’re way beyond “car” now. You’re in a Sylvan Motor Carriage. Ride in a style that’s all your own – from a different time, a different place. Drive a vehicle that keeps its priorities straight – more motor, less cup holder. Drive a Sylvan Motor Carriage and they’ll see. They’ll all see.
0x9CD34ABE70758D4D: From Nicholas Wickerman’s Fine Furniture comes this charming dining chair. Simple, breezy; these chairs are perfect for any casual gathering. They provide comfort without sacrificing décor.  And with their strong but lightweight frames, they’re easy to rearrange for any occasion. You have a lot of options for your wicker needs, but you’ve gotta try a Wickerman’s!
0x1CE1A1D884609D01: Normal chairs are for boring Sims. You deserve something with a little more flair. With its sensual curves and tight laces, the Corset Chair practically dares you to sit on its lap. Treat yourself to this sinful delight from the Unmentionable Collection and you (probably) won’t be sorry. Who says chairs can’t have a little drama?
0xA8F15C5753F04161: You know that one chair at grandma’s house? The one she’d sit in while she sipped her tea, maybe scribbling away at a crossword puzzle or finishing up her cross-stitch? The one by the window, where she would just sit and people watch for hours until she began screaming bizarre things at the mailman and you brought her another cup of her “tea?” Thanks to Yesteryear, that can be your chair.
0x0736A80E79CD025D: For those who think that wicker is not up to the task of providing a heavy, “living” chair, we say you’ve gotta try a Wickerman’s! Sure, other loungers might tempt you with their fancy cushions, but you have yet to experience comfort until your body sinks back into a weave of slender, pliant twigs.
0xC73606F5D88EC245: The Decadent Hug surrounds you with plush cushions and polished curves. It's the most lavish piece in Unmentionables’ impressive collection. Each is made using the finest materials known to Sims and a comfy cushion to keep it honest. Falling into the Decadent Hug is effortless. Convincing yourself to climb out again? Not so easy.
0xF16093284F2A39CD: An anthropologist was studying a long-abandoned village in a faraway mountainous land when she stumbled across a large cave. Inside she found few signs of habitation, but there were many designs scrawled on the walls of the cave where someone had used a chunk of quartz as improvised chalk. All of the designs depicted this chair: half seat, half animal, all twisted.
0x31E0B5F398A3F125: First, we asked our designers to create the kind of chair a vampire would keep in his library. Then, we challenged our manufacturers to bring down the cost by replacing all of the old bones in the design with cheaper and sturdier materials. Now, we’re proud to present the final product to you. The Stately Reader: very regal and completely legal!
0xE590A75435382A65: This chair might not be the first pick on anyone’s list, but it is on a lot of people’s lists so it’s a pretty solid backup option. It doesn’t make a huge impression, but it really doesn’t offend in any way. That makes it pretty flexible, from a decorating perspective. The Solid Backup Chair: good enough.
0xEFCEE9156EB527C8: A game as ancient and intricate as chess deserves a platform with its own rich complexity. Play a game on top of this meticulously hand-carved table, and you’ll understand what those tiny warriors are fighting for. Give your chess pieces a home that gives worth to your pawn’s sacrifice, justifies your bishop’s gambit, and gives a kingdom to your king.
0x0B01A52242F11BA2: If there’s a more efficient way to tell time than with a 7-foot tall, 300-lb mechanical clock, we’ve certainly never heard of it. Bring the granddaddy of all timepieces into your home and show everybody what time it is. No single piece of furniture offers more atmosphere. Each brilliant tick is as clear and breathtaking as every magnificent tock. The Granddaddy Clock: it’s about time!
0x3D604234A5D6F3C6: Back in the old days, before they were integrated into every other thing, the things that told time were actually stand-alone objects. But they didn’t just display the current time. These objects had a ring of numbers, and little pointers that slowly rotated around and literally just pointed at the numbers you were supposed to be looking at that second. They were powered by black magic.
0xAB0A1B1CDB89171C: At Sim-plicity, we strive to find elegance in simple designs, even in clocks that aren’t quite so grand. Being fancy doesn’t have to mean a million twists and contours. This philosophy is infused into our new wall clock, which provides uncompromising beauty with a minimum of fuss. Your friends will swear it’s an antique, but you’ll know it’s Sim-plicity!
0x743D8B9E1D7765ED: Funny story… All of these columns were built straight, but were damaged when the column factory was hit by an extremely localized tornado. 0xC9AE864B84797646: Not all corners are created equal, so when you’ve got that funny little concave corner, Vick has the funny little solution you’ve been looking for. 0xD2BADE7BDA7517A9: Sometimes your building has a convex corner that leads right into another corner. 0x37AF9F8C95DD96A8: Why should convex left corners have all the glory? Vick loves all his cornice pieces and hopes you’ll enjoy building with them as much as he did designing them!
0x2385D7C2E7566A44: Strait cornices are great, but they’re beyond useless without a corner. Luckily Vick’s thought of that to create the convex corner piece. 0x960958283AD9E4BC: The Blueprint Mode button can be found in both Build and Buy Modes. Use this tool to place fully-furnished rooms to your lot.
0x960958283AD9E4BF: In Blueprint Mode, the sort tabs will assist you in finding the type of room you want to place. For example, the Bedroom Tab has a variety of master and guest bedrooms. Be sure to check the Miscellaneous Tab for unique additions to your home. Rooms are sorted by price.
0x960958283AD9E4BE: Once you have found a room that you want to place, click on the icon to bring up the Preview Panel. The Preview Panel will display the room's wall and object layout.
0x960958283AD9E4B9: After selecting a room from the catalog, the blueprint is attached to your cursor. Move your cursor to where you would like to place the room and click to place the blueprint. You can place additional blueprints as long as you have enough funds. Room edges will snap together and create adjoining walls. The door will be moved to an available space between the rooms. If no space is available, the door will be placed in your family inventory or refunded. This is also true for wall decor.
0x960958283AD9E4B8: You can realign, reposition, or delete undesired blueprint placements with the Hand Tool. When you are satisfied with your blueprint layout, click the "Preview Blueprints" button located at the top of the screen to build and view your room. Choose "Accept" to finalize your changes or "Cancel" to return to the blueprint layout. Use the Undo and Redo buttons to fix unwanted changes.
0x960958283AD9E4BB: You can also use Blueprint Mode to quickly add additional rooms to your existing house. Blueprints can be placed on higher floors as long as there is proper support on the floor below. Note that you will have to manually place stairs in order to gain access to upper levels.

0xB0E9CE1A728BE4E1: The Academic panel is the place to go to keep an eye on your Sim’s academic progress. This panel contains the details of your Sim’s schedule, the responsibilities you need to fulfill to earn a high grade, and the academic progress meter to give you an idea of how your Sim is doing during the term.
0xB0E9CE1A728BE4E2: Every Sim is given a schedule at the beginning of the term. Most schedules will consist of seminar classes in academic buildings on Monday and Wednesday, Lectures and Class Activities outside of the classroom on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and Exams on Fridays.
0xB0E9CE1A728BE4E3: The academic progress meter is the best way to monitor your Sim’s progress during the term. Grades are calculated after the last Exam of the term, and keeping the academic progress meter high is the way to ensure good grades.
0xB0E9CE1A728BE4E4: There are many ways to affect the academic progress meter. Most degrees share a set of standard responsibilities: Attending Classes, Lectures, and Class Activities are all important ways to gain academic performance.
0xB0E9CE1A728BE4E5: Studying outside of scheduled class time is also very beneficial to academic performance. Sims may study in several ways. Textbooks, computers, and even your Sim’s smart phone are all great ways to get a little academic boost. Studying for too long can be detrimental though, so study in controlled doses.
0xB0E9CE1A728BE4E6: Each Sim is awarded a major-specific object to use outside of class. Using these objects and building the skills associated with your Sim’s major is a valuable addition to academic progress as well.
0xB0E9CE1A728BE4E7: With all of these great ways to contribute to your Sim’s academic performance, don’t forget that University Life is more than just academics. Take a break to recharge occasionally!
0xB0E9CE1A728BE4E8: For those Sims who are all about taking a break, cheating is an option. Sims can create cheat sheets to help them through a tough Exam, or even ask other Sims to attend class or take Exams for them. Cheating is risky though – getting caught can severely impact academic performance.
0xFD197C27603B8FE6: Academic life can be challenging but very rewarding. Would you like to learn more about managing your academics?

0x9CD7B8A3B547E971: A University degree is a valuable thing for a Sim to have. Sims with degrees start at higher job levels, earn more pay, get career bonuses more frequently, and earn career experience faster!
0x9CD7B8A3B547E972: There are six possible University degrees, and each degree gives your Sim a leg up in its associated careers.
0x9CD7B8A3B547E973: A Business degree is useful for Sims trying to succeed in the busy world of Business, Criminal enterprises or Education. Technology majors will find ample opportunities in Military and Law Enforcement careers.
0x9CD7B8A3B547E974: A degree in Science & Medicine will prepare any Sim for the demanding careers of Science and Medicine. Future Politicians, Journalists, and Fortune Tellers should invest in a Communications degree.
0x9CD7B8A3B547E975: Fine Arts is the degree for Sims interested in careers in Music, Culinary, or Film. Physical Education degree is perfect for Professional Sports junkies.
0x9CD7B8A3B547E976: Regardless of the degree you have chosen to earn, your final grade is important to your success in the outside world. The higher your grade when you graduate, the better the career benefits. For instance, Sims with an “A” final grade will automatically get career offers at level 4, with a significant pay boost over Sims with no degree.
0x25E1786EEA21FCF6: Earning a University degree comes with many benefits. Would you like to learn more about the degrees University has to offer?
0x4177819139B162FF: Dorms are great places to live for Sims looking to make new friends while in University. Fraternities and Sororities are even known to throw frequent parties!
0x4177819139B162FC: To make living in a dorm a little easier, be sure to Set Bed Ownership. This will assign specific Sims to use a specific bed. You can choose to do this just for your Sims or for everyone living in the dorm.
0x4177819139B162FD: Another helpful dorm setting is the ability to lock doors to only allow certain Sims through them. Clicking on a door will not only allow you to use standard lock settings, but to tie specific Sims to a door. Want to keep everyone but your Sim out of your dorm room? Use the lock setting!
0x4177819139B162FA: Your roommates definitely have minds of their own. If the dorm is getting messy, use the Social “Ask Roommate To…” to get your roommates to clean up, repair broken objects, or even make dinner.
0x4177819139B162FB: If you have a particularly difficult roommate that you just can’t live with, click on that Sim and choose “Dismiss Roommate” to kick them from the dorm! If you’d like to go through official channels, the Administration Center also takes requests to have roommates reassigned.
0x29F07E96483A2054: Dorms, Fraternities, and Sororities are communal living at its finest. Would you like to learn more about living in dorms?
0x292356BE47D94001: Enrolling in University is as simple as using a phone or computer. However, before enrolling Sims should consider taking the Sims University Aptitude Test. This test is available on the University Welcome Kit.
0x292356BE47D94002: The Sims University Aptitude Test will convert all those hard-earned skills, career experience, and even traits into University benefits like scholarships and free credits. This test is a great benefit to Sims who want to prepare for University before enrolling.
0x292356BE47D94003: Use the phone or computer to Enroll in University. Any Sim young adult or older is eligible to enroll. Once in the enrollment screen, there are lots of options for each Sim.
0x292356BE47D94004: Choose who to take to University and who stays home by moving Sims between the left panel and middle panel. The middle panel also shows you the tuition information for the Sims attending University, as well as any scholarships earned through the Aptitude Test.
0x292356BE47D94005: The right panel contains the enrollment options for each Sim. First select the degree you’d like for your Sim to work toward while in University. Each degree gives different career benefits once earned.
0x292356BE47D94006: After selecting a degree, choose the number of credits. The higher the number of credits a Sim takes, the greater the class load once they are in University. More credits means earning a degree faster, but may leave little time for socializing.
0x292356BE47D94007: Term length is an option for all Sims attending University. Sims must return home occasionally to touch base and re-enroll for another term in University. For a longer time away from home, choose 2 terms.
0x5646DC3FACB3F886: Enrolling is the first step in experiencing all that University has to offer. Would you like to learn more about enrolling in University?
0x9B84EB1633081B67: PlantSims are unique and have different needs than normal Sims. For instance, since they are more flora than fauna, they do not need to eat and will absorb nutrients from their surroundings. They also utilize fluids in a far more efficient manner than normal Sims and never need to empty their Bladder.
0x9B84EB1633081B64: In order to stay Hydrated and avoid getting Dried Out, PlantSims absorb Water by coming into contact with it. They can do this by bathing, swimming, or absorbing puddles. PlantSim babies and toddlers are naturally hydrated and don’t require Water.
0x9B84EB1633081B65: During the day, PlantSims have the ability to Photosynthesize which causes them to burrow under the ground and absorb Energy and Water. They also have the gift to Commune with Plants in order to help with their Social needs.
0x9B84EB1633081B62: PlantSims also have unique ways of expressing their fondness or dislike for Sims with kisses. Flower Kisses are a way to make a Sim obsess over your PlantSim while Poisonous Kisses will turn their stomachs. Other Sims can socialize with PlantSims to Ask for Herbs.
0x9B84EB1633081B63: PlantSims, being a product of nature and science, will learn the Gardening and Science Skills at an accelerated rate. That being said, PlantSims can also be cured with a visit to the Science Center or with a Bottle of Super Spice.
0x9B84EB1633081B60: If you wish to further your PlantSim family, you need only acquire a Forbidden Fruit and tend to it until it can be picked. Once it has reached this state, you have a chance to pull up your own little bundle of joy!

0xA5AA58A7ED974A43: Roommates are Sims who share your home, but aren’t controllable members of your household.
0xA5AA58A7ED974A40: There are a few ways to gain roommates. If you have a specific Sim in mind to be your new roommate, simply build up your relationship and use the "Ask to Be Roommate" social.
0xA5AA58A7ED974A41: If you aren’t as picky about who moves in, you may advertise for roommates using the phone. Click “Real Estate and Travel Services” then select “Roommate Services” to enable roommate options. You can specify how many roommates you’d like and what genders you prefer.
0xA5AA58A7ED974A46: Roommates will generally start to arrive on your lot after 9:00 am the day after you advertisement goes out. Roommates will contribute rent to your household weekly based on the number of roommates you have and the value of your lot.
0xA5AA58A7ED974A47: Since roommates are uncontrollable additions to your household, use the social “Ask Roommate To” to get them to clean up around the house, repair broken objects, or even make a meal.

0x4D0F0B5D314562EB:
Congratulations on your acceptance to Sims University!

Rewarding, successful careers await you, with the best jobs going to graduates with the highest grades. So how do I earn high grades, you ask? Good question!

Regardless of how many classes you take, you’ll earn one comprehensive grade for the entire term, and it’s based primarily on your exam scores. To do well on your exams, your Academic Performance should be as high as possible when you take the exam (being in a good mood and getting a good night’s sleep won’t hurt either). Academic Performance is increased by going to class, attending lectures, participating in outside class activities, and studying.

You have also been given a special study object related to your specific major – a very useful tool for building your academic performance.

Classes begin tomorrow and are held every Monday and Wednesday. Tuesdays and Thursdays are for outside Class Activities and attending Lectures in the Student Union Building. On Fridays, you’ll go back to the classroom to take exams. Refer to the Academics panel for your schedule, grades and other information.

You’re here to earn a degree, but be sure to enjoy yourself, too. Welcome to Sims University!
0x72C00D5E3099632C:
Welcome to the Nichols School of Business at Sims University. Business students will run the world of the future, and the faculty are committed to your academic success.

All students in the Business major receive a Business Planner when they enroll, offering countless opportunities for growth both inside and outside of the classroom. Keep it with you at all times; you never know when inspiration will strike!

Classes, Lectures, and Class Activities are required for all students, but Business majors will receive extra credit for building their Charisma and Social Networking skills.

Every winning smile and hour of careful planning will pay off after graduation. Give yourself a leg up in the Business and Criminal careers, joining them at higher positions with better pay than lesser-educated Sims. Be careful not to coast while dreaming of future rewards—employers will see your entire transcript! Higher grades translate directly to better career advancements once you hit the open market.

Our faculty wishes you the best of luck in your academic endeavors, and welcome again to Sims University!
0x64CAE5EEA83CFB75:
Welcome to the Nichols School of Business at Sims University. Communications students will shape the next generation of media and marketing, and the faculty are committed to your academic success.

All students in the Communications major receive a Mobile Radio Station when they enroll. It’s a phenomenal tool for developing your skills and media presence outside the classroom, and most in-class activities will also make use of it. Carry the Mobile Radio at all times!

Classes, Lectures, and Class Activities are required for all students, but Communications majors will receive extra credit for building their Writing and Photography skills.

Every hour spent reporting campus events will pay off after your graduation from Sims University. Communications graduates join Journalism, Politics and Fortune-Telling careers at higher levels with higher pay than less-educated Sims. Keep your grades up and your senses keen to journalistic possibilities; the better your performance at University, the better your job prospects after graduation.

Our faculty wishes you the best of luck in your academic endeavors, and welcome again to Sims University!
0xC6721172FD2BF588:
Sims University likes to make sure all students are well informed of the degree options offered, as well as the benefits for earning a degree from our institution.

Regardless of the degree you have chosen to earn, your final grade is important to your success in the outside world. The higher your grade when you graduate, the better the career benefits.

A Business degree is useful for Sims trying to succeed in the busy world of Business or Criminal enterprises.

Technology majors will find ample opportunities in Military and Law Enforcement careers.

A degree in Science & Medicine will prepare any Sim for the demanding careers of Science and Medicine. 

Future Politicians, Journalists, and Fortune Tellers should invest in a Communications degree.

Fine Arts is the degree for Sims interested in careers in Music, Culinary, or Film.

A Physical Education degree is perfect for Professional Sports junkies. DO NOT TRANSLATE
0xFAA4FCF48E6FB0D8:
Welcome to the Thomas School of Art at Sims University. Fine Arts students pursue noble endeavors without promise of reward, and the faculty are committed to your academic success.

All students in the Fine Arts major receive a Sketchbook when they enroll, which will assist your skill development both inside and outside the classroom.  Keep it with you always, and sketch anything that might catch your eye.

Classes, Lectures, and Class Activities are required for all students, but Fine Arts majors will receive extra credit for building their Street Art, Painting, Cooking and Guitar skills.

Every brushstroke and flip of the spatula will pay off in the years to come. Fine Arts graduates may join Music, Culinary and Film careers at higher levels with better pay than lesser-educated Sims. Keep your grades as glorious as your imagination; the higher your grades at the Thomas School, the better you’ll be positioned to succeed in the highly competitive world of Fine Art.

Our faculty wishes you the best of luck in your academic endeavors, and welcome again to Sims University!
0xC07FC0BB153DC9E1:
Welcome to the Schmidt Memorial Stadium and Annex at Sims University. Physical Education students will spend their careers training and entertaining all of Simkind. It’s for that reason that the faculty is utterly committed to your academic success.

All students in the Physical Education major receive an Anatomy Skeleton with enrollment. Use this tool to Study Skeletal Structure outside of class, and to follow along with the professors’ instructions when you go to class.

Classes, Lectures, and Class Activities are required for all students, but Physical Education majors receive extra credit for building their Athletic skills.

Every rep in the weight room and every drop of sweat will yield rewards after graduation, when you’ll have the inside track to high positions and excellent pay in the Professional Sports career. Excellent grades will only enhance these valuable bonuses, so work your tail off in the classroom and on the practice field!

Our faculty wishes you the best of luck in your academic endeavors, and welcome again to Sims University!
0x5B9A627BB1CE0254:
Welcome to the Busche School of Science at Sims University. Science and Medicine students develop the next generation of groundbreaking therapies and add to our understanding of the Universe.  The faculty is absolutely committed to your academic success.

All students in the Science and Medicine majors receive an Anatomy Skeleton at enrollment. Use this tool to Bone up on Anatomy outside of class, and to follow along with the Professors’ instructions when you go to class.

Classes, Lectures, and Class Activities are required for all students, but Science and Medicine majors receive extra credit for building their Science, Gardening and Fishing skills.

Every sample taken and every pipette squeezed will be rewarded handsomely after your graduation from Sims University. With a degree in Science or Medicine, you’ll be eligible to join the Science and Medical careers at higher levels with higher pay than other Sims. Your grades are crucial for these bonuses, and better performance will yield material rewards once you join the workforce.

Our faculty wishes you the best of luck in your academic endeavors, and welcome again to Sims University!
0xB25B9C4677A9D474:
Welcome to the Busche School of Science at Sims University. Tomorrow’s technology will come from today’s Technology students, and for that reason the faculty are totally committed to your success.

All Technology students receive a Brain Enhancing Machine when they declare their major. This ingenious device can boost your academic performance when used outside the classroom, but it’s also a necessary tool for in-class activities. Be careful not to fry your neurons!

Classes, Lectures, and Class Activities are required for all students, but engineers must learn by doing. Technology majors receive extra credit for building their Handiness, Logic, and Inventing skills.

Every tightened screw will pay off when you’ve got your Sims University degree in hand. Technology graduates may join the Law Enforcement and Military careers at higher levels with higher pay than Sims without their special expertise. The better your grades, the greater these professional perks will be.

Our faculty wishes you the best of luck in your academic endeavors, and welcome again to Sims University!

0x251434BEEFB1C98E: Earn some money on the side or choose to run your own high powered mega-resort. Resorts allow your Sims to have the opportunity to run their own business. There are different ways to obtain a resort. Select "Become a Resort Owner" from your phone and choose a lot that you want to build a resort on. If you already own a private residential lot or island, click on the map tag and choose "Convert to Resort".
0xB31F2E714B197C7A: Keep tabs on your resort operations by viewing the Finances menu. This can be found on the front desk or on any wall or roof on your resort. Here you can view key statistics such as occupancy, revenue, and expenses. Choose to update amenity business decisions or hire new employees directly from this panel. Keep your finances balanced to prevent your resort from being closed down.
0xB31F2E714B197C7B: Get feedback about how your resort is performing by checking out the Resort Reviews panel. This selection can be found on the front desk or on any wall or roof on your resort. Here you can view your current star rating and read comments from your guests about their recent stay. Improve your resort based on reviewers' feedback or keep things just the way they are. It's really up to you. Hey, if you're making money, why change anything?
0x251434BEEFB1C98D: Now that you own a resort, it is time to build it out and customize it. Use Build and Buy Modes to build structures and place down key resort amenity objects. Resort specific catalog sorts allow you to easily find objects that allow business operation options. Decorations also contribute to your resort rating. If you're looking for a quick way to build your resort, you can try using Blueprint Mode. There are new resort-specific blueprints to choose from.
0x251434BEEFB1C98C: When using blueprints to build out your resort be sure to read the special instructions or hints for each type. Some blueprints will require you to set additional settings in Live Mode in order for them to work properly.
0x251434BEEFB1C98B: VIP door locks are specific to resorts and will need to be set for each guest room whether built through a blueprint or build/buy. In Live Mode click on a door to add a new or existing VIP door lock. You will want to assign a unique VIP door lock key to all doors that lead to a guest room. Note that resort towers don't need door locks as they're automatically managed by the resort.
0x251434BEEFB1C98A: Customize employee uniforms to fit the theme of your resort. Choose a preset theme for all resort employees from the front desk or change it for each worker by selecting the option directly from the amenity object. A higher level of customization is available by clicking on a worker and choosing to create a customized uniform. Custom uniforms are assigned per Sim so hiring a new employee will force the default outfit.
0x251434BEEFB1C989: Before you open your resort to the public, here are a few tips on how to keep your new business profitable. One of the main goals for managing resorts is to maintain a healthy occupancy level. The happiness of your resort guests are a big part of what makes sure that they keep coming back for more. Provide a good amount of amenities for your guests to enjoy and make sure your pricing is appropriate to your current star rating. Finding this balance is key to a profitable resort!
0x251434BEEFB1C988: Open your resort from the front desk and guests should immediately start filing in. Some resort amenities will allow you to make business decisions. Choose wisely as there are benefits and drawbacks to every decision. Employees will automatically be hired for your front desk, bar, and food stand but you always have the power to replace them.
0x251434BEEFB1C987: Busy resorts will require maintenance. Hire maintenance workers from the front desk or save some money and do all of the cleaning and fixing yourself. Higher level workers are more efficient in doing their job. Keep your resort clean. Nobody likes a dirty resort.
0x251434BEEFB1C986: Amenity workers such as ones you hire to operate the front desk, food stand, and bars are permanent employees. Thus they are listed individually in your finance panel. However, maintenance workers are temporary and can be swapped out with another NPC without you even knowing about it so don't be surprised if you see a new worker cleaning up your resort. This is why they are all lumped in as a single category called "Maintenance Workers" in your finance panel.

0xBEE7E91DD557EADE: The Bot Building Skill is perfect for Sims who like to design and create mechanical companions. The Bot Workshop is the main tool for developing your Sims’ Bot Building Skill.
0xBEE7E91DD557EADD: Designing and Creating Nanites is the easiest way to build your Sims’ Bot Building Skill. Nanites can also be found and gathered in the future. Reverse-Engineering a Nanite will break it down into components for more advanced Bot Building creations as well as teach your Sim how to create that type of Nanite.
0xBEE7E91DD557EADC: Just like Nanites, Sims can design and create Trait Chips at the Bot Workshop. Trait Chips give advanced functionality and behavior to the most advanced Bot Building Skill Creation: Plumbots.
0xBEE7E91DD557EADB: Plumbots are robotic Sims from the future! Sims can create their own Plumbots from the Bot Workshop or purchase them from the Bot Emporium in Oasis Landing. Although Plumbots are created without any chips installed, Sims can add Trait Chips to enhance their Plumbots in all sorts of different ways.
0xBEE7E91DD557EADA: Adding and removing Trait Chips to Plumbots is a snap when your Sims Adjust Trait Chips. You can add or remove Trait chips to your Plumbots at any time, they can even adjust their own Trait Chips! Plumbots start with only a few Trait Chip slots, but can have more unlocked with a higher Bot Building Skill and by using Upgrade Trait Chip Slots.
0xBEE7E91DD557EAD9: All Plumbots also have a quality level determined by the Bot Building Skill of their creator. Plumbots of a higher quality will have their maintenance and battery power drain at a slower rate. In addition, they will be more valuable should your Sim decide to sell them.
0x047CFFF7A66FAA1D: Building Bots requires hard work and a steady hand, but it’s very rewarding! Would you like to know more about the Bot Building Skill?
0x1D6E5F63DB155062: Meet Emit Relevart, aka the “Time Traveler.” Out of all the times and places Emit’s visited, Oasis Landing is his favorite. He will serve as both your guide and, if you so choose, mentor on your journey Into The Future.\n\nTalk to him  to receive Time Traveler Training, make Oasis Landing more Dystopian or Utopian, or to discover more about the Future.
0x1D6E5F63DB155061: To Travel to the Future, select the Portal, which Sims you would like to take, and jump in! Don’t have a Portal? Just wait for the Time Portal to appear on your lot or purchase one from the catalog. While you are in Oasis Landing, there’s no need to worry about your Home World. During your time away, Time is paused. There’s no need to rush, so stay as long as you’d like!
0x1D6E5F63DB155060: There are a plethora of new objects that can be found throughout the world when Oasis Landing is altered to be in its Dystopian or Utopian State. These objects include things like Delightfully Oversized Flowers, Curious Dew, Trash Piles, Geyser Rifts, and much, much more!\n\nYou will even have unique ways of interacting with Sims while in these alternate Timelines!
0x1D6E5F63DB155067: There are several ways to revert Oasis Landing to its default state, which also resets ANY edits made to the Town.\n\nAttain level 10 Advanced Technology Skill to Reset the Time Continuum on the Portal or earn enough Lifetime Happiness to buy the Time Remote Control to change Oasis Landing’s Future while in your Home World.
0xD862BFD808969249: Actions in the past can have a profound and unexpected effect on the Future. Would you like to know more about Time Travel?
0x9F409BCA4BEAC5A8: Plumbots are fully customizable members of your household! Creating a Bot is much like creating a Sim. If you don't like the initial random Bot you have been given, you can select a Pre-made Bot or generate a new random one.
0x9F409BCA4BEAC5AB: Use the buttons on the left navigation panel to customize all the physical attributes of your Bot, from Head to Hover Jets!
0x9F409BCA4BEAC5AA: Don't forget to enter Create a Style to give your Plumbot a truly customized look. Heads, torsos, arms, and legs can all be styled to create a unique Bot of your very own.
0x9F409BCA4BEAC5AD: And of course once you've made a Bot masterpiece, use the options in the More menu to Save your Plumbot to the Bin or Share them with others!
0x9F409BCA4BEAC5AC: When you are happy with the appearance of your Plumbot, the Accept button will take you back to Live Mode. Don't stop there though. Your Bot needs a personality to go with their shiny new chassis. Use the Bot Workshop to create trait chips, and install them to give your Plumbot a mind of their own!
0xA52D93055480D127: Plumbots are machines that have the power to transform and enrich a Sim’s life. Would you like to know more about Create-a-Plumbot?
0x0867414145B9AB40: Every Sim has the potential to have Descendants! A variety of factors can affect the family lineage, starting with your genetics. Your appearance and traits will have an impact on what your Descendants look like and how they behave, and may even affect their family worth. The Almanac of Time is an easy way to learn more about your Descendants and can help you find where they live. Be sure to stop by and visit them when your Sim is in the future!
0x0867414145B9AB43: Descendants are very volatile and prone to the effects of causality. Pregnancy, death and moving Sims into or out of your household will have a significant impact on your Descendants existence. Traits like Family Oriented will help improve the chances of your Sim having a larger Descendant family while traits like Commitment Issues may stifle the size of the Descendant family. It’s all about genetics, so too many traits similar to Commitment Issues may breed your Descendants out of existence.
0x0867414145B9AB42: How well off your Descendants are is up to you. Having traits that focus on finance, creativity and work ethic, coupled with your Household Funds and owned Real Estate could set your Descendants up for success. Of course, lazy, unmotivated and uncreative Sims are destined to leave their Descendants destitute. Lucky and Unlucky traits can add that extra push to make or break the bank.
0x0867414145B9AB45: Visiting your Descendants is a fun and rewarding activity for your Sim to do in the future! You can greet your Descendants, hug them, joke about their household size and worth, and learn about your family history. As your relationship with your Descendant improves, you can even ask to stay over at your Descendant’s home!
0x0867414145B9AB44: Your Descendants don’t always stay the same, and changes in traits, Supernatural type or family size could push them out of existence. If a Descendant has succumbed to a time paradox and vanished, head to the Mausoleum – if you are quick enough you might be able to bring them back! Be wary of the Dream Pod and Unstable Trait, both have a habit of causing paradoxes.
0xB9D1EC829FD002FF: While in the Future world of Oasis Landing, make sure to see how your Descendants have come along. Would you like to know more about Descendants?
0x316A4BC9E39C76C6: The Dream Pod changes Sims lives by providing the ability to dream with lasting effects from the dream after a Sim wakes. A Dream Pod can be used like a normal bed for sleeping and relaxing, but the greatest effects come from dreaming. To start a dream, simply select Dream on the Dream Pod. This will bring up a menu showcasing themes your Sim can dream about. More dream options will appear as your Sim gains Advanced Technology Skill.
0x316A4BC9E39C76C5: Don’t stop at just selecting a dream theme though! You can actively influence the dream to be positive or negative while your Sim is dreaming. To do this, click on the Dream Pod and choose Influence Dream... The options you choose in this pie menu will affect the type of dream your Sim is having. Keep an eye on the thought bubbles above your Sim while dreaming to know if the influences are good or bad, as well as your Sim’s moodlets to discover the overall tone of their dream.
0x316A4BC9E39C76C4: Dreams will stay with your Sim even after they wake. Depending on the influences on the dream, as well as your Sim’s mood and traits, your Sim can either have a Good Dream, Neutral Dream, or Bad Dream. Take a look at your Sim’s moodlets to see how their dream affected them. A dream’s effect can range from a simple change in mood to drastically changing your Sim’s personality!
0x316A4BC9E39C76C3: For double the fun, share a dream with a friend or household member. Your Sim may also join in on a dream that is in progress. Dreaming together is a great way to share the effects of a dream. The future of sleep has arrived, so buy your Sims a Dream Pod today!
0xE68C2D5982689225: The Dream Pod has the power to shape dreams that can positively (or negatively) affect a Sim’s day. Would you like to know more about the Dream Pod?
0x3F876A1A5A3D9CD4: With time and practice, Sims will gain enough Advanced Technology skill to master many futuristic objects! A Sim with low Advanced Technology skill is more prone to failures, but with a higher skill a Sim will become more successful in using Advanced Technology objects. Additionally, more interactions will unlock as a Sim masters the skill. Obtaining higher skill reduces the chance of Time Sickness from occurring in addition to unlocking new future timelines.
0x3F876A1A5A3D9CD7: Sims will gain Advanced Technology skill at an accelerated rate while in Oasis Landing. To start gaining the skill, simply use any of the following objects: Drink Synthesizer, Time Portal, Food Synthesizer, Jetpack, Windcarver, Dream Pod, Sonic Shower, Air Tube Elevator, and Holo-Computer while Playing Computer Games or Looking Up Friends on Holoweb.
0x0FFF3C30884157CB: Technology from the Future requires time and patience to master. Would you like to know more about Advanced Technology?
0x9BF098606D10A16B: The Windcarver allows for quick travel throughout your neighborhood. To use it, place the Windcarver in your Inventory and then select “Use Instead of Walking.” Anytime your Sim is outside, they’ll choose to use the Windcarver instead of walking. If your Sim has an automobile set as their preferred transportation, the car will be used instead of the Windcarver. To stop using the Windcarver, click on it in the Inventory and choose “Don’t Use Instead of Walking.”
0x9BF098606D10A168: Ready for your Sims to reach new heights? Try out the Jetpack! To equip it, place it in the inventory and then select “Start Using Jetpack.” After it’s equipped, new interactions will appear when clicking on the Jetpack for traveling to other lots. Clicking on the Sim will also show new interactions. When two Sims have Jetpacks equipped, there is even more fun to be had on the Jetpack! To remove, click on the Sim’s Jetpack and choose “Stop Using Jetpack.”
0x9BF098606D10A169: The City of Oasis Landing has an extensive public transportation network known as the ZEPHYR. To use it, travel to any of the four ZEPHYR stops and click on the station, then choose “Travel to…” Three options will be available for you to choose for the destination stop. Hop on and enjoy the ride!
0x41BB8B5CCAD4B9A8: The Futuristic city of Oasis Landing has many options for transportation. Would you like to know more about Futuristic Travel?
0xB9573B5CB7EEE399: Plumbot Competitions are a staple of Oasis Landing Entertainment. Classes and Training also take place at the Plumbot Competition Arena. Plumbots can begin Entering Competitions at the Beginner level without any Trait Chips Installed! Competitions award cash prizes, trophies, and the adoration of the crowd! Keep in mind, when your Plumbot competes, their Needs will decrease, so it’s best to Enter when they are high.
0xB9573B5CB7EEE39A: While your Plumbot is Competing, you are the one that sets the Pace! Modify your Pace throughout the competition to give your Plumbot a break or that little extra boost.
0xB9573B5CB7EEE39B:
Playing It Safe grants the highest success chance, smallest bonus chance, and no penalty chance.

If you Take Risks, you also have a medium to high success chance, medium bonus chance, and small penalty chance.

Going For Broke yields a moderate success chance, large success bonus, and large penalty chance.
0xB9573B5CB7EEE39C: Competing at higher levels such as Advanced or International requires the Limitless Learning Trait Chip as well as a certain amount of Skill based on the type of Competition.\n\nBattleBot Competitions require Athletic Skill, Bot Building Competitions require Bot Building Skill, and EmotiBotting Competitions require Charisma.
0xB9573B5CB7EEE39D: Plumbots increase their chances of winning by making sure their Needs are high and using the appropriate Trait Chips.  For example, the Efficient Trait Chip gives Plumbots a bonus to all types of Competition while Simulated Emotions will benefit Plumbot in an EmotiBotting Competition. Professional Tune Ups also give you a little extra kick so it’s best to know someone in the Bot Arena Career.
0x572F44508DD7E45E: Plumbots make great companions, but they also make great competitors too. Would you like to know more about Plumbot Competitions?
0x66546ECB5A7EC278: The Time Traveler has chosen to bestow the Almanac of Time to your Sim! The Almanac of Time is shared between all members of your Active Household and can be accessed from your Sim’s Inventory.\n\nReference the Time Almanac to explore Oasis Landing’s alternate Futures, view your Active Household’s Future Descendants, or to find more info about Oasis Landing’s Legacy Statues.
0x66546ECB5A7EC27B: From the Events Tab, you can read about and directly trigger the alternate Future Opportunities to make Oasis Landing more Dystopian or Utopian. You can even trigger the Opportunity to revert it back to its Normal state.
0x66546ECB5A7EC27A: While in the Future, the Descendants Tab will display your Active Household and each member’s Descendants. Clicking the Magnifying Glass will show you where your Descendants live. Your Descendant’s Family Worth and Household Size are also reflected here and may change based off your Active Household’s Traits and their Household Funds.
0x66546ECB5A7EC27D: The Legacy Statues Tab displays the commemorated founders of Oasis Landing. Selecting a Legacy Statue from the list will display the title of the Sim and the deeds they are remembered for. Clicking on the Magnifying Glass while in the Future will take you to where the Legacy Statues are located. The requirements for earning a Legacy Statue as well as its reward can also be found under this tab.
0xA951C7886B05FEF7: The Time Almanac is the perfect companion for Time Travel! Would you like to know more about the Time Almanac?
0x55063151D50D0AEA: If your Sim wants to be immortalized and famous in the Future, there is no better way to accomplish this than to earn a Legacy Statue! There are five different statues your Sims can have recreated in their image by performing different tasks in the present day. By doing these things in the present, your Sim helps change the course of the Future!
0x55063151D50D0AE9: These statues are The Lustrous Entertainer, The Pioneer of Plumbotics, The Renowned Philanthropist, The Time Keeper, and The Trendsetter. Each statue grants your Sim a unique benefit when they are in the Future, so earn them all for maximum rewards. In addition, other Sims will cheer and applaud your Sim for their contributions in shaping the Future.
0x55063151D50D0AE8: The Almanac of Time is a great place to find out more about Legacy Statues. Here you can learn about each statue, what you need to do to achieve each statue, and what the unique reward for achieving each statue is.

0x3B956C0AA995BA41: • Win the Lotto in present day, then…\n• Donate {0.Money} to the Plan the Future Fund at present day City Hall.
0xC0EEACF9438E1AF4: Being the Sim of the People symbolizes a warm heart and a friendly gesture. Meet, befriend, and entertain the community to be remembered throughout time.\n\n(Match the record and beat one category to earn this title.)
0x239016D83ABA7DE3: Thrown by the whims of fate into contact with a mysterious Time Traveler, {0.SimName} befriended him and proceeded to master the art of timeline manipulation.
0x8C770BD8766B2C54: Receive the Time Remote which allows different timelines to be set at the click of a button!
0x9B2252D87DF9B333: • Become Best Friends with the Time Traveler, then…\n• Change the Future to Dystopia and Utopia, then…\n• Repair the Future Timeline back to Normal Oasis Landing.
0xECCA54513242351C: Fashion isn’t created like most art. It’s improvisational, and {0.SimName}’s unique sense of style spread until it became synonymous with a wonderful, empowering future.
0x55B147516DF2E0B3: Nearby Sims will periodically change into the same outfit that you're wearing.
0x6704A05177C38614: • Set up a Clothing Pedestal in present day, then…\n• Have {0.Number} Sims use the Clothing Pedestal to change their outfit, while in present day.
0x654C325FCE90E840: After decades of selfish and irresponsible decisions, Sims strained Oasis Landing to the limit and beyond. Trash heaps block the sidewalks, meteors pulverize the landscape, and dangerous Rifts have formed beckoning adventures to climb inside to find their treasures.
0x950A657EDB0E5F1A: This alternate future is thrill seeker’s paradise dotted with dangerous geysers and meteors that light up the sky. Whether you’re here for a day or an eternity, just remember that surviving is the ultimate reward. And what could be more thrilling?
0x1368292DC9E444CD: The town of Oasis Landing is a bustling city filled with hidden treasures and places to explore. Whether you’re adventuring into the Wasteland, taking in a Bot Competition, or visiting those who’ve shunned technology, there’s lots to do in Oasis Landing!
0x071D0B8043D659F8: Inspired by centuries of whimsical stories, the Sims of Oasis Landing built a paradise! Flowers bearing Dews dot the landscape and nobody can account for strange buried gold being found about town. The locals walk around joyfully, greeting each other with whimsical waves.
